subject: Cleaning Up California’s Voter Rolls
body:
Trump Assassination Attempt Update
| | | ****
---
---
|
---
| **Judicial Watch Sues California to Clean Up 873,000 Inactive Voter Registrations****[](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=81693&L=37919&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g/dj1kM0RIQ3RiLUFNcyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=0fe82befb8b83a1b331e12dd1d21f72803b46c4701fe24ee3d7e31f0449508f0)**
California has a dirty voting rolls crisis – with thousands of old names on the rolls going back at least 10 years. Dirty voting rolls can mean dirty elections. We filed a federal [lawsuit](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=81693&L=37899&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL3dhZ25lci12LXdlYmVyLWNhLW52cmEtY29tcGxhaW50LTAxMjYzLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=cd45b628c432a619bcd0901e957459026a2387372c22e94466f96e835b1572e3) on behalf of a California political candidate and a state political party against the State of California due to its failure to maintain accurate voter rolls as required by the National Voter Registration Act (NVRA) ([_Don Wagner et al. v. Shirley N. Weber, in her official capacity as California Secretary of State_](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=81693&L=37899&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL3dhZ25lci12LXdlYmVyLWNhLW52cmEtY29tcGxhaW50LTAxMjYzLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=cd45b628c432a619bcd0901e957459026a2387372c22e94466f96e835b1572e3) _ _(No. 8:26-cv-01263)).Federal law requires most inactive voter registrations to be removed after two general federal elections. This- new federal lawsuit alleges, based on admissions in prior Judicial Watch litigation, that 873,092 voter registrations have remained continuously inactive for at least three federal elections, and some for much longer. Of these registrations, 326,808 have remained continuously inactive through at least three consecutive federal general elections, while 151,202 have remained inactive through at least four consecutive federal general elections.In addition, 33,922 voter registrations have remained continuously inactive through at least five consecutive federal general elections — dating back at least ten years, to before the November 5, 2016, presidential election.Under the National Voter Registration Act of 1993 ([NVRA](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=81693&L=4368&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuY29uZ3Jlc3MuZ292L2JpbGwvMTAzcmQtY29uZ3Jlc3MvaG91c2UtYmlsbC8yP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=0923439d0da9956dc97059c7401429fd89f8965482b4ab1687b84695fc861158)), states are required to make reasonable efforts to remove ineligible voters from the voter rolls, including those who have died or moved. The lawsuit also alleges, again citing admissions by California officials, that the state takes no effective action to require counties to comply with the NVRA. As a result, they do not comply.

We sued on behalf of Don Wagner, an elected member of the Orange County Board of Supervisors and candidate for California Secretary of State, and the American Independent Party of California.In June 2025, the U.S. Election Assistance Commission (EAC), as required by law, issued a report to Congress on states' NVRA compliance. Citing this report, we point out that 20 California counties removed 50 or fewer inactive voters from their rolls between November 2022 and November 2024. Ten of these counties reported zero removals of inactives under the relevant statute during that time period. These include Alpine, Imperial, Inyo, Kings, Mariposa, Mendocino, Plumas, San Bernardino, Tehama, and Trinity. Counties reporting 50 or fewer removals include Butte, Colusa, Contra Costa, Glenn, Lassen, Modoc, Santa Cruz, Siskiyou, Sonoma, and Tuolumne.

We argue:
> The 20 counties reporting zero to 50 registrations pursuant to NVRA Section 8(d)(1)(B) during the period from November 2022 to November 2024 reported a combined total of 3,440,358 voter registrations to the EAC. Yet these 20 counties reported removing a grand total of just 218 registrations under that provision during that period.
For context, we note that San Diego County, with 2.2 million registered voters, removed over 300,000 voter registrations under that statute during the same time period.

Currently, over 23 million Californians are [registered](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=81693&L=37900&F=H&&hash=96e224632a6f5e405a12a10480d5f9468148691dcc403448a3a7ef8604c555a4) to vote.Additionally, we state that Census Bureau data shows:
* 660,000 California residents moved out of state in 2024;
* 690,000 in 2023; and
* 818,000 in 2022.

We point out that if California “was actually conducting a general program that makes a reasonable effort to cancel the registrations of voters who have become ineligible because of a change of residence, it would not be possible” for these counties to cancel so few registrations under the NVRA in a two-year period.”

The lawsuit also notes that “comparing the total number of voter registrations reported to the EAC in each California county to the U.S. Census Bureau’s most recent five-year estimates of voting-age citizenry indicates that 18 California counties have more voter registrations than citizens over the age of eighteen.”

In March 2019, the State of California and Los Angeles County settled a December 2017 lawsuit with us that resulted in the removal of more than 1.2 million names from voter rolls.

We filed the lawsuit in the U.S. District Court Central District of California Western Division. The complaint asks the court to declare California in violation of Section 8(a)(4) of the NVRA and to permanently enjoin the state from further violations. It also seeks an order requiring California to implement a lawful voter-roll maintenance program to remove ineligible registrants.Judicial Watch is assisted by the Benbrook Law Group of Sacramento, California.We are a national leader in election integrity and voting rights litigation, with a record of [successful lawsuits](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=81693&L=37921&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvdGFnL2VsZWN0aW9uLWxhdy8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=1fdef1fb29506980e74d00b5482349199da9f795ee91348384c98ed241d62766) enforcing constitutional redistricting standards and cleaning voter rolls nationwide.

**Judicial Watch Sues for Records on ‘Havana Syndrome’ Investigations**[Havana Syndrome](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=81693&L=37895&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuY2JzbmV3cy5jb20vbmV3cy9oYXZhbmEtc3luZHJvbWUtd2hpdGUtaG91c2UtY2FiaW5ldC02MC1taW51dGVzLTIwMjItMDItMjAvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=67fda4921b314ceacf3a0c4de83f96a436f85d8283582f5eeb45d280bdec61c6) is a mysterious set of cognitive and neurological ailments named after cases first reported among diplomats at the U.S. embassy in Cuba. U.S. Department of Justice, et al_](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=81693&L=37893&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWhhdmFuYS1zeW5kcm9tZS1jb21wbGFpbnQtMDE3MDIvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=619545b4d257fe134b44b7d22bc5afef1b09f043872525bf03a5b386e5e11cfa)[.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=81693&L=37893&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWhhdmFuYS1zeW5kcm9tZS1jb21wbGFpbnQtMDE3MDIvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=619545b4d257fe134b44b7d22bc5afef1b09f043872525bf03a5b386e5e11cfa) (No. 1:26-cv-01702)).The lawsuit follows the government’s failure to respond to multiple FOIA requests submitted by Judicial Watch in February 2026 for extensive records dating back to 2016 regarding investigative, analytic, and operational response to Havana Syndrome affecting U.S. personnel both domestically and abroad. The agencies include:
* Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI),
* Central Intelligence Agency (CIA),
* Defense Intelligence Agency (DIA),
* Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI), and
* U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE),

According to the complaint, the FBI request seeks “all records created, received, or maintained” by the Bureau’s Counterintelligence Division, Weapons of Mass Destruction Directorate, and field offices relating to Havana Syndrome investigations, including files indexed under classifications such as Espionage, Sabotage, Domestic Security, and Foreign Counterintelligence. The request also seeks FD-302 interview reports, electronic communications, case files, and interagency coordination records with intelligence and national security partners.Our FOIA requests further seek CIA records addressing technical and scientific analysis of potential causal mechanisms for Havana Syndrome, including directional energy, pulsed radiofrequency energy, and ultrasonic or infrasonic hypotheses, as well as intelligence assessments regarding possible foreign attribution, including Russia, China, and Cuba.We are also asking for Defense Intelligence Agency records relating to its internal Havana Syndrome investigation reportedly led by retired Army Lt. Col. Greg Edgreen, as well as records concerning the dismissal of former DIA Director Lt. Gen. Jeffrey Kruse and related congressional findings.In addition, we are seeking ODNI records related to Intelligence Community Assessment methodology, coordination processes, dissenting analytic views, and evidentiary standards used in Havana Syndrome-related assessments, including the March 2023 Intelligence Community Assessment and subsequent updates.The complaint further includes a FOIA request submitted to U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement seeking records regarding the alleged acquisition and testing of a directed-energy or pulsed-energy device reportedly obtained through Homeland Security Investigations and studied for potential relevance to Havana Syndrome symptoms.Federal agencies have stonewalled basic transparency on Havana Syndrome for years. The American people—and the dedicated public servants affected—deserve answers about what happened, what the government knew, and when it knew.

A September 26, 2012, [report](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=81693&L=37903&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cub2lnLmRocy5nb3Yvc2l0ZXMvZGVmYXVsdC9maWxlcy9hc3NldHMvUERGcy9PSUctUk9JLUkxMi1VU1NTLU9TSS0wMDgwMC5wZGY/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=3b4df7e3a4cfbc7e3f16f8b1416be5e6e85603089971ef3f74bc51482b8b3fa3) from Homeland Security Office of Inspector General, prepared in response to queries from several senators, found:
> [W]e identified 13 USSS [Secret Service] employees who had personal encounters with female Colombian nationals consistent with the misconduct reported in April 2012, around the time of advance activities for the President’s visit to Cartagena. These encounters took place at the Hotel Caribe, the Hilton Cartagena Hotel and at a private residence.
> Our investigation determined that 12 of the 13 USSS employees met 13 female Colombian nationals at bars or clubs and returned with them to their rooms at the Hotel Caribe or the Hilton Cartagena Hotel.

> Through our interviews, we learned that following their encounters, 3 females left the rooms without asking for money, 5 females asked for money and were paid, and 4 females asked for money but were not paid. In addition, one female, who asked to be paid but was not, brought a Colombian police officer to the door of the USSS employee’s room; the employee did not answer the door. clean_body: Trump Assassination Attempt Update | | | ** | | Judicial Watch Sues California to Clean Up 873,000 Inactive Voter Registrations** California has a dirty voting rolls crisis – with thousands of old names on the rolls going back at least 10 years. Dirty voting rolls can mean dirty elections. We filed a federal on behalf of a California political candidate and a state political party against the State of California due to its failure to maintain accurate voter rolls as required by the National Voter Registration Act (NVRA) ( (No. 8:26-cv-01263)).Federal law requires most inactive voter registrations to be removed after two general federal elections. This- new federal lawsuit alleges, based on admissions in prior Judicial Watch litigation, that 873,092 voter registrations have remained continuously inactive for at least three federal elections, and some for much longer. Of these registrations, 326,808 have remained continuously inactive through at least three consecutive federal general elections, while 151,202 have remained inactive through at least four consecutive federal general elections.In addition, 33,922 voter registrations have remained continuously inactive through at least five consecutive federal general elections — dating back at least ten years, to before the November 5, 2016, presidential election.Under the National Voter Registration Act of 1993 (), states are required to make reasonable efforts to remove ineligible voters from the voter rolls, including those who have died or moved. The lawsuit also alleges, again citing admissions by California officials, that the state takes no effective action to require counties to comply with the NVRA. As a result, they do not comply. We sued on behalf of Don Wagner, an elected member of the Orange County Board of Supervisors and candidate for California Secretary of State, and the American Independent Party of California.In June 2025, the U.S. Election Assistance Commission (EAC), as required by law, issued a report to Congress on states' NVRA compliance. Citing this report, we point out that 20 California counties removed 50 or fewer inactive voters from their rolls between November 2022 and November 2024. Ten of these counties reported zero removals of inactives under the relevant statute during that time period. These include Alpine, Imperial, Inyo, Kings, Mariposa, Mendocino, Plumas, San Bernardino, Tehama, and Trinity. Counties reporting 50 or fewer removals include Butte, Colusa, Contra Costa, Glenn, Lassen, Modoc, Santa Cruz, Siskiyou, Sonoma, and Tuolumne. We argue: The 20 counties reporting zero to 50 registrations pursuant to NVRA Section 8(d)(1)(B) during the period from November 2022 to November 2024 reported a combined total of 3,440,358 voter registrations to the EAC. Yet these 20 counties reported removing a grand total of just 218 registrations under that provision during that period. For context, we note that San Diego County, with 2.2 million registered voters, removed over 300,000 voter registrations under that statute during the same time period. Currently, over 23 million Californians are to vote.Additionally, we state that Census Bureau data shows: 660,000 California residents moved out of state in 2024; 690,000 in 2023; and 818,000 in 2022. We point out that if California “was actually conducting a general program that makes a reasonable effort to cancel the registrations of voters who have become ineligible because of a change of residence, it would not be possible” for these counties to cancel so few registrations under the NVRA in a two-year period.” The lawsuit also notes that “comparing the total number of voter registrations reported to the EAC in each California county to the U.S. Census Bureau’s most recent five-year estimates of voting-age citizenry indicates that 18 California counties have more voter registrations than citizens over the age of eighteen.” In March 2019, the State of California and Los Angeles County settled a December 2017 lawsuit with us that resulted in the removal of more than 1.2 million names from voter rolls. We filed the lawsuit in the U.S. District Court Central District of California Western Division. The complaint asks the court to declare California in violation of Section 8(a)(4) of the NVRA and to permanently enjoin the state from further violations. It also seeks an order requiring California to implement a lawful voter-roll maintenance program to remove ineligible registrants.Judicial Watch is assisted by the Benbrook Law Group of Sacramento, California.We are a national leader in election integrity and voting rights litigation, with a record of enforcing constitutional redistricting standards and cleaning voter rolls nationwide. Our lawsuits and legal actions have caused of six million ineligible names from voter lists nationwide. Robert Popper, a Judicial Watch senior attorney, leads our election law program. Popper was previously in the Voting Section of the Civil Rights Division of the Justice Department, where he managed voting rights investigations, litigations, consent decrees, and settlements in dozens of states. In April 2026, we announced a in our federal lawsuit against Oregon election officials, which confirms ineligible voter names are slated for review and removal from voter registration lists. Colorado recently removed 372,000 ineligible voter names thanks to a Judicial Watch addressing the state’s compliance with federal voter list maintenance requirements. In Kentucky, state election board officials that “roughly 735,000 ineligible voter registrations” have been removed from voter rolls, as part of a 2018 consent decree settling a Judicial Watch lawsuit. As part of its 2022 , New York City alone has removed 918,139 ineligible names from its rolls: removals between March 2023 and February 2025, which is in addition to the 441,083 previously reported removals. Our legal pressure also resulted in election roll clean-ups in , , and federal court in has ruled that our lawsuit to force the cleaning of voter rolls may proceed in that state. We sent a notice-of-violation letter to election officials in California, and legal action over the state’s voter rolls is imminent. In March 2026, the Supreme Court of the United States held in a landmark election integrity case over whether the federal Election Day laws prohibit the counting of mail-in ballots that arrive after Election Day. We brought the underlying lawsuit on behalf of the Libertarian Party of Mississippi. In January 2026, in a historic case we filed, the Supreme Court in favor of Congressman Mike Bost and two presidential electors who were before the court to vindicate their standing to challenge an Illinois law allowing the counting of ballots received up to 14 days after Election Day. Judicial Watch Obtains 911 Call from Father of Alleged Trump Shooter Crooks We’re successfully uncovering details of the attempted assassination of President Trump in Butler, Pennsylvania.The Bethel Park, Pennsylvania, Police Department has, in response to a court order, released an placed by the father of , who is alleged to have attempted to then-presidential candidate Donald J. Trump at approximately 6:11 p.m. during a campaign rally in Butler, PA, on July 13, 2024.Thomas Crooks’ father, Matthew Crooks, called 911 on the evening of the shooting, just before 11:00 p.m., because he was concerned his son was missing and had not returned home: Hi, hi, yes, my name’s Matthew Crooks. I was calling in regards to my son Thomas. He, he belongs to the Claritin Sportsmen Club in Claritin.... The reason I’m calling is he left the house here at about a quarter till 2:00 this afternoon. And we’ve gotten no contact from him, no text messages, nothing’s been returned, and he’s not home yet.... Like I said, he belongs to the Claritin Sportsmen Club or Gun Club, and he took a rifle of his out there, and it’s, it’s routine. He always does it, but he’s usually back within 2 hours.... And we’ve been texting him, leaving him messages on his phone. He’s not been returning any of our texts or messages, which is totally not like him. And, you know, we’re, we’re going on 11:00, and he still hasn’t come back or contacted us, so we’re kind of worried. We don't know if he’s been in an accident or if something else happened to him. The release follows a Pennsylvania Right-to-Know Law request filed by Ken Silva of Headline USA in July 2024 seeking access to the recording and related records. The Bethel Park Police Department denied the request. On appeal, the Pennsylvania Office of Open Records (OOR) affirmed the denial, asserting that the audio was exempt from disclosure, citing its alleged connection to an active criminal investigation involving the Federal Bureau of Investigation and the Pennsylvania State Police.In October 2024, Judicial Watch, through local counsel, filed a of the denial in the Pennsylvania Commonwealth Court on behalf of our client, Ken Silva, and Headline USA, (. SA-24-000675)).In June 2025 we, again through local counsel, filed for in camera (private) review of the disputed audio recording. The court granted that request, reviewed the material privately, and ultimately ordered its release on April 24, 2026, subject to redactions of personal identifying information.This audio 911 call is another piece of the puzzle in the Butler assassination attempt on President Trump.J. Chadwick Schnee, Esquire, of Schnee Legal Services, LLC, is assisting us as local counsel.In February 2026, a separate Judicial Watch lawsuit forced the release of the first FBI about the Butler assassination attempt, revealing that law enforcement personnel broadcast radio warnings about an “unknown male acting suspiciously” prior to the shooting.In April 2026, we Department of Homeland Security (DHS) for records related to an August 31, 2025, incident in which a club member allegedly carried a loaded semi-automatic handgun past Secret Service screening checkpoints at Trump National Golf Club in Virginia while President Donald Trump was on site.In April 2026, our FOIA lawsuit forced the release of from the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) that show that Crooks was reportedly involved in an altercation with a group of people and making “hateful comments” directed at President Trump at Butler, PA.In December 2025, we the U.S. Secret Service for communications records related to Code Pink protesters who disrupted a dinner held by President Trump at a restaurant in Washington, DC, on September 9, 2025 ( (No. 1:25-cv-04408)).In September 2025, we filed a FOIA for messages among top leaders of the FBI referencing social media posts of Special Agent Jeffrey Veltri, head of the Miami Field Office, which is investigating the September 15 assassination attempt against Donald Trump ( (No. 1:24-cv-02740)).In March 2025, we Homeland Security for records related to security provided for the July 13, 2024, rally in Butler, PA ( (No. 1:25-cv-00704)).In August 2024, we documents from the district attorney’s office in Butler County, PA, detailing the extensive preparation of local police for the rally at which former President Trump was shot. The preparation included sniper teams, counter assault teams and a quick response force.In August 2024, in response to a separate open records request, we obtained bodycam footage of the July 13 assassination events from the Butler Township Police Department.In August 2024, following up on reports that the Biden Secret Service denied Trump’s requests for additional Secret Service protection, we filed a FOIA for Secret Service and other records regarding potential increased protective services to Trump’s security detail prior to the attempt on his life at his July 13 campaign rally ( (No. 1:24-cv-02495)). Judicial Watch Sues for Records on ‘Havana Syndrome’ Investigations is a mysterious set of cognitive and neurological ailments named after cases first reported among diplomats at the U.S. embassy in Cuba. Former Deputy National Security Adviser Charles Kupperman has said that he believes the number of people who have reported anomalous health incidents is , if you include family members with symptoms.Kupperman also stated that such incidents were not confined to overseas locations, noting that two government staffers reportedly were affected just steps from the White House.We filed a federal Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) against the U.S. Department of Justice and four other federal agencies, seeking records concerning anomalous health incidents (AHIs), commonly referred to as “” ( (No. 1:26-cv-01702)).The lawsuit follows the government’s failure to respond to multiple FOIA requests submitted by Judicial Watch in February 2026 for extensive records dating back to 2016 regarding investigative, analytic, and operational response to Havana Syndrome affecting U.S. personnel both domestically and abroad. The agencies include: Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI), Central Intelligence Agency (CIA), Defense Intelligence Agency (DIA), Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI), and U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), According to the complaint, the FBI request seeks “all records created, received, or maintained” by the Bureau’s Counterintelligence Division, Weapons of Mass Destruction Directorate, and field offices relating to Havana Syndrome investigations, including files indexed under classifications such as Espionage, Sabotage, Domestic Security, and Foreign Counterintelligence. The request also seeks FD-302 interview reports, electronic communications, case files, and interagency coordination records with intelligence and national security partners.Our FOIA requests further seek CIA records addressing technical and scientific analysis of potential causal mechanisms for Havana Syndrome, including directional energy, pulsed radiofrequency energy, and ultrasonic or infrasonic hypotheses, as well as intelligence assessments regarding possible foreign attribution, including Russia, China, and Cuba.We are also asking for Defense Intelligence Agency records relating to its internal Havana Syndrome investigation reportedly led by retired Army Lt. Col. Greg Edgreen, as well as records concerning the dismissal of former DIA Director Lt. Gen. Jeffrey Kruse and related congressional findings.In addition, we are seeking ODNI records related to Intelligence Community Assessment methodology, coordination processes, dissenting analytic views, and evidentiary standards used in Havana Syndrome-related assessments, including the March 2023 Intelligence Community Assessment and subsequent updates.The complaint further includes a FOIA request submitted to U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement seeking records regarding the alleged acquisition and testing of a directed-energy or pulsed-energy device reportedly obtained through Homeland Security Investigations and studied for potential relevance to Havana Syndrome symptoms.Federal agencies have stonewalled basic transparency on Havana Syndrome for years. The American people—and the dedicated public servants affected—deserve answers about what happened, what the government knew, and when it knew. Judicial Watch Sues Secret Service over Obama-Era Prostitution Scandal More than a decade after the Cartagena prostitution scandal embarrassed the Secret Service and raised questions inside the Obama White House, the public still has not seen the full story.We filed a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) for records related to the 2012 scandal in Cartagena, Colombia ( (1:26-cv-01555)).We sued in the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia after the Secret Service failed to respond to a February 19, 2026, FOIA request for: All emails and text messages sent between officials in the U.S. Secret Service and officials in the Office of the White House Counsel, including but not limited to White House Counsel Kathryn Ruemmler, relating to a controversy involving Secret Service officials and other U.S. government employees using the services of prostitutes during an Obama visit to Cartagena, Colombia in 2012. A September 26, 2012, from Homeland Security Office of Inspector General, prepared in response to queries from several senators, found: [W]e identified 13 USSS [Secret Service] employees who had personal encounters with female Colombian nationals consistent with the misconduct reported in April 2012, around the time of advance activities for the President’s visit to Cartagena. These encounters took place at the Hotel Caribe, the Hilton Cartagena Hotel and at a private residence. Our investigation determined that 12 of the 13 USSS employees met 13 female Colombian nationals at bars or clubs and returned with them to their rooms at the Hotel Caribe or the Hilton Cartagena Hotel. Through our interviews, we learned that following their encounters, 3 females left the rooms without asking for money, 5 females asked for money and were paid, and 4 females asked for money but were not paid. In addition, one female, who asked to be paid but was not, brought a Colombian police officer to the door of the USSS employee’s room; the employee did not answer the door. As a result, she was paid by another USSS employee and left. All told, the Secret Service investigated 12 people in connection with the Colombia incident. The was seven resignations, three employees receiving administrative punishment, one termination and one retirement.At least 10 military personnel involved in Obama’s trip also invited prostitutes to their rooms. Multiple law enforcement and congressional sources alleged involvement by members of the White House , as well.The Secret Service’s refusal to turn over records about communications with the Obama White House raises serious transparency concerns. Our lawsuit aims to uncover exactly what Secret Service officials were telling the White House during one of the most embarrassing security scandals in modern presidential history.In April 2026, we the U.S. Department of Homeland Security for records related to an August 31, 2025, incident in which a club member allegedly carried a loaded semi-automatic handgun past Secret Service screening checkpoints at Trump National Golf Club in Virginia while President Donald Trump was on site.Also in April, our FOIA lawsuit forced the release of from the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) that show that would-be Trump assassin Thomas Crooks was reportedly involved in an altercation with a group of people and making “hateful comments” directed at President Trump at the Butler, PA, rally site before the July 13, 2024, assassination attempt.In February 2026, our lawsuit forced the release of the first FBI about the Butler assassination attempt.In December 2025, we the U.S. Secret Service for communications records related to Code Pink protesters who disrupted a dinner held by President Trump at a restaurant in Washington, DC, on September 9, 2025 ( (No. 1:25-cv-04408)).In September 2025, we filed a FOIA against the U.S. Department of Justice for messages among top leaders of the Federal Bureau of Investigation referencing social media posts of Special Agent Jeffrey Veltri, head of the Miami Field Office, which is investigating the September 15 assassination attempt against Donald Trump ( (No. 1:24-cv-02740)).In March 2025, we the U.S. Department of Homeland Security for records related to security provided for the July 13, 2024, rally in Butler, PA ( (No. 1:25-cv-00704)).In August 2024, we documents from the district attorney’s office in Butler County, PA, detailing the extensive preparation of local police for the rally at which former President Trump was shot. The preparation included sniper teams, counter assault teams and a quick response force.In August 2024, in response to a separate open records request, we bodycam footage of the July 13 assassination events from the Butler Township Police Department.In August 2024, following up on reports that the Biden Secret Service denied Trump’s requests for additional Secret Service protection, we filed a FOIA for Secret Service and other records regarding potential increased protective services to Trump’s security detail prior to the attempt on his life at his July 13 campaign rally in Butler, PA ( (No. 1:24-cv-02495)). | A personal note from Steve | Before June 2nd
---|---
Dear Friend, I wrote this because I do not want this moment to pass quietly. You get a lot of campaign emails. I know that. Most of them are overly urgent and instantly forgettable.
| | ★ |
---|---|---
Deadlines. Buttons. Exclamation points. The usual performance. **This is not that.** I wrote you a real note because **June 2nd is almost here** , and after that, this race moves on with us or without us.
|
---
Please read what I wrote | [Read My Message](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=96ccbd1a6e594b57be13279d54087d16&_e=SqwGwJm6h3UW0q70Bq6cotZc7XdOV0i2HbcpKyFSLQepUgF40hRAoqyKvZ_4ME87puuGvcJTxrzOSQkGwYSGliUSka7RtcPUVmXGuCusfxyWt4PxpO1bzFLQ2o6VS-t-hrOXlp3Fj8H53oBn7u0kAoTbzz5LxIs0heFZaBVRKk28PtcHI-0yrZ0DLrcn5M-aqNoUTa2_Q-tE2hCWz7xQ3gNC4BbNJQx88rEkJaZ97LkGUwP70oImzYSbM7Pfm-BWfmgyxMU5twSlZnkfCBTaxP2qyLBG1i8ddxX-L5WpZXnuCiiSuSftHyMad8_CKcAB0RLA77CAUFDUPV-bznolhytwaSk8KrL2UKaQ0Ebem3AIJuv7wwVm6VMMjKFu7uTzwz8n1u2OwhVPafwTELt0Cc9jjFqSQktDuLQ83ZSSffHY2p6abOwkO5x7Z7lJNSyLeoTHhYcL7J9_2py4xArWxjlzXkuRV_yXhO2s0w2g3wQ%3D)
---

| There is no automatic Republican nominee in California. There is no second chance if we fall short. There is no clever explanation that will make up for failing to do everything possible while there was still time.
---
**That is the brutal, unavoidable fact.** And frankly, I do not want this to be the last serious message I send to Americans across the country about this campaign because Democrats managed to stop us before November. **That would be a bitter, ridiculous ending to a fight we can absolutely win.**
| Before the window closes Help me keep this campaign moving. | [Stand With Me](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=96ccbd1a6e594b57be13279d54087d16&_e=SqwGwJm6h3UW0q70Bq6cotZc7XdOV0i2HbcpKyFSLQepUgF40hRAoqyKvZ_4ME87puuGvcJTxrzOSQkGwYSGliUSka7RtcPUVmXGuCusfxyWt4PxpO1bzFLQ2o6VS-t-hrOXlp3Fj8H53oBn7u0kAoTbzz5LxIs0heFZaBVRKk28PtcHI-0yrZ0DLrcn5M-aqNoUTa2_Q-tE2hCWz7xQ3gNC4BbNJQx88rEkJaZ97LkGUwP70oImzYSbM7Pfm-BWfmgyxMU5twSlZnkfCBTaxP2qyLBG1i8ddxX-L5WpZXnuCiiSuSftHyMad8_CKcAB0RLA77CAUFDUPV-bznolhxuH5IN2Td1IezUN4A9MgH4oOBEiBIfX0rxZf9dG0nAeJdVqdXsJ3PF8WrnwdOijYFNclzHXRzGphll584oVFcghcp4_D5dov1CJTxe4sasJ0GidYCANYGrgf2TOkNGTUbgfjMP0xEx8CNt_Wfjwms0%3D)
---
So before you scroll past another campaign email, I want you to read the note I wrote. It explains exactly where this race stands, why Democrats want us buried before June 2nd, and why I believe they are terrified of facing us one-on-one in November. They should be.
|
---
_Thank you,_
_Steve Hilton_

Instead of lowering costs, they've pushed reckless tariffs that hurt families, small businesses, and farmers here in Washington. Instead of protecting healthcare, they've backed policies that could force millions of people to pay more or lose coverage altogether. And instead of helping working families get ahead, they passed another massive tax giveaway for billionaires and big corporations. At the same time, we're seeing attacks on reproductive freedom, dangerous misinformation about vaccines from people like RFK Jr., and cruel immigration policies that leave families living in fear. # [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21486?t=1&akid=41399%2E3422442%2Ewe087F)
Big news, Peter:
**The McClatchy Media California editorial board endorsed Katie Porter for governor** after conducting interviews with every major Democratic candidate and Republican Steve Hilton. They called her “by far the most impressive” out of all the candidates.
That endorsement represents five major California newspapers: _The Sacramento Bee, The Modesto Bee, The Fresno Bee, Merced Sun-Star, and The San Luis Obispo Tribune._
And what put Katie over the top?
_Her agenda. Plain and simple._
Katie understands the challenges working families face because she’s lived them herself.
She’s a single mom of three. She drives an old minivan. She knows what it feels like to worry about rising costs, shrinking budgets, and not having enough breathing room at the end of the month.
Katie isn’t running to protect billionaires or corporate interests. She’s running to lower costs, take on Big Oil and corporate greed, and fight for the people who are getting squeezed every single day.
**That’s why this endorsement matters so much. It proves that when voters hear Katie’s message, they respond to it.**
But here’s the reality: ballots are _already_ in mailboxes, and the primary election is less than two weeks away.
That means we’re in the most critical stretch of this campaign. Every voter we reach and every conversation we spark could make the difference. So we’re asking:
**[Will you chip in to power Katie’s campaign and reach undecided voters across California?](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_kp_20260522_3_ak.urpOx9&refcode=em20260522-41399&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=41399%2E3422442%2Ewe087F)**

Team Katie Porter

Katie is running to be California’s next governor because California and our country need a leader who will stand up to Trump to lower costs, protect our rights, and combat climate change. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4g-em-footer?refcode=em20260522-41399&amounts=&t=23&refcode2=41399_3422442_we087F&akid=41399%2E3422442%2Ewe087F)**

name: NRSC HQ
subject: A solemn weekend, and a sickening reality.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the NRSC
body:
While we honor our fallen heroes, the Democrats' handpicked candidate is mocking them.

Friend,

Memorial Day is a sacred time for our country. This weekend, families across America will lower their flags, visit cemeteries, and pause to honor the extraordinary heroes who sacrificed everything for our freedoms.

_But today, it also forces us to look at a sickening reality about the modern Democrat Party._

**[Because while patriots like you are honoring our troops, Democrat Senate candidate Graham Platner is viciously mocking them.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2znjhk25ju3toecrj7ts5n3ajd646p7106vi11nsg_rp22sh2s8i6epr4slj6eor6c1h2bs)**

**[I want to tell you about Pfc. Ted Daniels:](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zlsb0pe45n9pij7qbgth2retbj6huuj4h1111nr0_rp22sh2s8i6epr4slj6eor6c1h2bs)** In 2012, Pfc. Daniels intentionally moved out into the open to draw heavy Taliban fire and protect his unit. **[He fought bravely, was shot four times, and was awarded the Purple Heart.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zten3bst3s0ns562ug67m7osoj7nr6t2bhi0kcv8_rp22sh2s8i6epr4slj6eor6c1h2bs)** He is _**[exactly](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdbv4kgkeqv4cmpk9rn5dppscseev21tuidodi7o_rp22sh2s8i6epr4slj6eor6c1h2bs)**_ the kind of hero we honor this weekend.

**[Here is what Graham Platner had to say about him:](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zig219888f4kp3cu1bl0r072q8t40ga6kfhlqtbg_rp22sh2s8i6epr4slj6eor6c1h2bs)**

"Dumb motherf***** didn't deserve to live."

"Poor marksmanship on the Taliban's part is the only reason this mouthbreather made it home..."

Let those words sink in, Friend. A man running for the U.S. Senate looked at a wounded American soldier, mocked him for surviving, and practically cheered for the Taliban.
******************************************************[DEFEND PFC. DANIELS& OUR TROOPS](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztvqf3p2bo2l8sjh1kqioc1kqkrd13ps24mp5kpo_rp22sh2s8i6epr4slj6eor6c1h2bs)******************************************************
**[But Platner didn't stop there.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zea70buq2t3nv4012tfohe9nhmsq6i74533qs9u8_rp22sh2s8i6epr4slj6eor6c1h2bs)**

He smeared legendary Navy SEAL Chris Kyle, claiming the American Sniper shot innocent civilians.

He praised a Hamas terrorist attack as a "damn fine looking and successful raid."

He claimed that most U.S. military members "have barely made a sacrifice" and shouldn't even receive the G.I. Bill.

_This is the absolute lowest of the low ..._
******************************************************[CHIP IN TO DESTROY HIS CAMPAIGN TODAY](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z86ia128h2kktfh1gc1cbdeeqid227hkirbhurjg_rp22sh2s8i6epr4slj6eor6c1h2bs)******************************************************
Graham Platner is a man with a years-long pattern of cruelty, recklessness, and staggering immaturity. Yet, the national media and the Democrat establishment are completely silent.

**[They are perfectly willing to cover up this depravity as long as Platner can buy them a Senate seat.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z9gu9i05egtn5l0t62sk55f3gadg5bgq4smskcug_rp22sh2s8i6epr4slj6eor6c1h2bs)**

We cannot let that happen. If we truly respect our military, we must draw a hard line in the sand.

**[During this solemn Memorial Day weekend, I am asking you to help us defeat Graham Platner, expose his disgusting record, and defend the honor of our armed forces.>>](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z9g2nflm53f7ipjff0qsi5hdsenaq2gu3j722kr0_rp22sh2s8i6epr4slj6eor6c1h2bs)**

**[We owe it to Pfc. Daniels, to Chris Kyle, and to every man and woman who has ever worn the uniform, to keep people like Graham Platner out of power.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdh3ua5ccn8cl5o9gp91j40cmc2b30nbonmsd6o0_rp22sh2s8i6epr4slj6eor6c1h2bs)**

Thank you for standing with us, and God bless our troops.

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | | Open your banking app. Go to settings. name: The PreBorn! Team
subject: What she saw on the ultrasound changed everything
body:
Natally never thought she would become a mother.

| | | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zre85l1bgvv7ifr5bj828sld227ln6k0d09kmfbo_rp22sh2s8i6epr4slgm2o76cth2bs)
---
Natally never thought she would become a mother. As a child, she had been told she couldn’t have children, and after years of trying during marriage, she eventually accepted that reality. But in 2023, after walking through divorce, addiction recovery, and one of the hardest seasons of her life, she stared down at a positive pregnancy test in complete shock. “I didn’t tell anyone,” Natally shared. “I felt so alone at that time.” Fear quickly took over. The father of the baby did not want to be involved, and Natally became overwhelmed by the thought of raising a child completely on her own. Though she had been raised in church, she admitted that for the first time in her life, abortion crossed her mind. “If I don’t go through with this,” she thought, “all the criticism will come back. If I do, no one will ever know.” [**Then an old coworker told her about a PreBorn! Network Clinic.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z9mf2306jc1eq5l18p2bg2f1n92n82mddc439h70_rp22sh2s8i6epr4slgm2o76cth2bs) Natally walked into the Clinic carrying fear, shame, uncertainty, and the weight of everything she had been through. But instead of judgment, she found compassion. Someone listened to her, held her hand, and reminded her that her story was not over. Then came the ultrasound. Natally admitted she was terrified. “I refused, at first, to even look at it (the screen),” she said. “It was the hardest thing.” But when she finally looked up, she saw something she says she will never forget. **“The sac she was in was heart-shaped,”** Natally**shared. “I felt like it was God giving me peace.”** That moment changed everything. Today, Natally’s daughter is thriving after surviving an extremely premature birth at just 24 weeks. Natally calls her daughter “my miracle” and “my medicine.” Friend, stories like Natally’s are why PreBorn! exists. Right now, women across the country are walking into abortion facilities believing they have no other choice but to end their pregnancies. Many feel overwhelmed, afraid, pressured, or completely alone.
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zq7spvrgdmqms04gbvcp67kcjnm5oaotdtmh6dog_rp22sh2s8i6epr4slgm2o76cth2bs)
---
**But an ultrasound changes that. When a mother sees her baby on the screen and hears the heartbeat, fear is interrupted with truth. That moment creates space for hope, clarity, and life.** In fact, when abortion-vulnerable women receive an ultrasound at a PreBorn! Network Clinic, more than 80% choose life for their babies. **[Before a mother makes a permanent decision, she deserves the opportunity to hear her baby’s heartbeat.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5jttja175iirm2irdq09onj5q4mtonrr117ipc8_rp22sh2s8i6epr4slgm2o76cth2bs)**
---
* $28 provides 1 life-saving ultrasound
* $56 provides 2 ultrasounds for mothers in crisis
* $140 helps 5 women see their babies and choose life
* $280 helps reach 10 women with compassionate care and the gospel

---
Your generosity helps make that moment possible. Please give your most generous gift now to help another mother hear her baby’s heartbeat and choose life.

## Consumer Confidence Hits 4-Year Low
American confidence in the [economy hit its lowest point](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO4yAURb8Gd47gYYxdUGzjLttuab2Yh_12MERAEuXvR5lfmPpK9-icf9f1ihw57X_xJNdCXhO9aqTWqKztESvveLth8YUq76n6tD2SX0HC2EvTg149cnyvQ-ddIALSHTll7Wy0nAbZHU6FME6TlDiindEo1JMJatYAAS0Y37H7vEkDWklplb2MdpJS42YoAI23TQySPLdcLv8zp3ZQiO_8pHLZ8tlFd7R2r0L_EbAIWNpBB8f42QQsRz7pIyRgQX9y4toKNs5JwGKmWSmpejyp8Iap9rTllM93nx8t5vzVx_yi2gQsXXH-_uIYuY5WDHI_kX8QXftVs6eD7wAAAP__BNiBRA) in nearly four years, with Gallup's Economic Confidence Index falling to negative 45 in May, a 7-point drop from April that matches a record low set in October 2022. Only 16% of Americans rated economic conditions as excellent or good in the Gallup survey, while nearly half said conditions are poor. Three-quarters say the economy is getting worse, the highest share since May 2023. ## List: Oldest Bar in Every State
A roundup of [the oldest bar in every state](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFyhCAQgOGn0U5nXUCwoEhz3aVN6SCsSsLhDeydc2-fubxC-n--4v-6zlcXU8zbp7uR5fWYM501ETOVmR-pxs0tiyuhUI1briH7Rw4zAo4dqA7FHFxMr1m2wa5ESKIlO2g9KQFGQrtbr40Mg5mMxkkYRbBMwXkFUk8DghrbaN8aKBQDgB50P2oDIJxXtCKNi28kUIh8lP77iJl3WtPreFLp_XFrk92Z77URHw1eGryc59nzTj-R_Z7fRYOXIwWq3C2udDF39KTy6io7pg6FNkJqbIsN9zOmFOuoGwnbzcX05_O_pjwt_gYAAP__Zmd1AQ) reveals that America's drinking history goes back a lot further than most people realize, with the winner dating all the way to 1673--or is it 1668? Rhode Island's White Horse Tavern has been serving drinks continuously since 1673 and holds the country's oldest tavern license. But New York's '76 House in Tappan argues that its building dates to 1668, which would make the structure itself older, even if regular whiskey service wasn't available. Of course, most states' older bars are far younger. You can trace the expansion of the United States by when the first bars opened in each new state heading west, until you reach Hawaii, where Smith's Union Bar didn't open until 1935. | Peter,
When I first got to Congress at 29 years old I created the Congressional Classroom, the first program of its kind in the country.
We brought students from Louisiana into the halls of Congress to learn how the government worked and most importantly to show them the process belonged to them just as much as it belonged to anyone else. That their vote was power. That democracy was theirs to shape.
I meant every word.
That program lives on today as the Louisiana Leadership Institute, and the students it shaped are out in the word right now making change. I am proud of every single one of them.

MAGA can redraw my district. They can cancel elections. They can try to silence the voice of the voters I represent. But they cannot take that fire. And as long as those students are watching, I will not stop carrying the torch they will someday inherit.

| | | You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.

You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with “entertainment” that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace.But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue’s Clues_...

[](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckdGKozAYhZ8m3kV-_5ioF15MsZbCdlla6LJXISaxDaP-YuIM8_ZLYecF9vaDc-Cc7_dFX0yYwvL4aWbfhhj1FvWwefP-pGn6-iRycaaFVpq-aNEIqDhIjkKvG8XV26SLzLUSi3qsM98WVdVIIVA12bNV9dg4EBbASQtiBNE0smmkA6zQqioL7asQJIoCSgVNXlhjXTniAEPtoKxZCfvqTPJ5WGJwPlqidaUppGBjTtsjm9pnSmtk4o1hz7CP3u6bz83iHaXc0sywHzbz4flA9B4Z9lgVEi3W3EmveDmUJa8LVXMvh0opX411UzDR72nWkfbNeia6Q3fi1-OdoXrh2buwz0x0x8s_Ys28mvBYmOgQUEJZgD50J324vt2P-nw6_UH5Q1-Pd_3rjZ9vt-8YLckviYnufLvx7y-yrXXrZ5imEFXFSnjMJkyvKVn6X0MfLf4NAAD__5Odm70)

And the Left will try to bury _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ at every turn. The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 – and with the recent launch, we need to raise the funds immediately.

## Teen Builds AI to Stop Wrong-Way Crashes
Recent Dallas ISD graduate Rohan Parthipan, now a Carnegie Mellon University freshman, has spent two years building an [AI dash cam](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOpCAUhZ8GOwxeRP4pKLaxm223NChXJQExgDK-_YZ5hb-890u-nHP-vae3ts4e21_tUeXPGqYDS3KYM8ZpjYjp8h6jR-1S0Y8Pp74STsBgoExQ4JPR1j1T3xg1M_PqGlSdlC_B-04Oza7Q9D0H1LgKKWEw3JiX7AQbfmYQTEBjVZUxAbzrGAjRws-KEgA5M8PccSA9Q2NziG3eMeNHp9U94cbYLsE3Tu05n4nwPwRGAmMppT3mxaylYgJj7UNgdGHRrp4h5p1-NTQjHlT7cGxUmzssOmOi55V2e2x0DZGWWFnRDzXR3vWbgruyDUdV9gwkDIzA2ERlzmKds2mQpGeb19Z94-XfjXor-B8AAP__IB-NYQ) designed to warn drivers heading the wrong way on the highway. His system uses a smart camera to detect the backs of street signs, a telltale marker of wrong-way driving, then triggers alerts within 30 to 45 seconds in field tests. Wrong-way crashes have long plagued North Texas. A wrong-way crash on U.S. 75 in Dallas [killed 23-year-old chef](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGunDAQheGnMd2s7MFgKCjS0N20KdGAxxdLA17Z5rL79tHmFVL_0pG-8-dr-aIo8fz-TQdP9RXScvJdhGvlvITMXK7j4HwwSbnpfaQnXYUX1NiD7gDbxVOU92IbP63aj6bhyTg3dq01rm_2yY6j6dGsA3XDFtp-W1tr0Dg9kiMi08TpM6Y7bI3R2HUPHAI7RG6171fTorKafawpP-rOlV9UgrzTD-fHlo5Gpr3WZ1HtL4Wzwvm-78cdiD5R4Uy5xk1Y4fxxKZwlbSSfIAIlXXVf03V6EDq5QApwFXAdlP2q4NN9QjzhTLnu4EmECviLoSYIVElgy1R2hTMODpiY3Wo0BGIDdqQBBhtW8HYMSJsZO7ZNnvzzjiKx9E5Z_X1QlH-M-n_n_0z4NwAA__9fnZgz) Christopher Ourfalian and another person on Tuesday, critically injured a third, and closed southbound lanes for hours. name: Douglas Carswell
subject: Mississippi School Enrollment Plummets — 70,000 Students Gone
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/usnationaldebt-12853414?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| _**If you're not in front of our Saturday email, you're behind.**_
---
| Dear Friend,
Jackson's Mayor John Horhn led the groundbreaking ceremony for the new Redeemer's School. On the site of the old Chastain Middle School — closed by the local school board after years of falling enrollment — there will now be a new school with a waiting list.
---
|
---
_School choice means more schools like Redeemer’s!_
| The very day Redeemer's celebrated their expansion, a new report showed a massive fall in the number of students enrolled in public schools across Mississippi.

Mississippi's public schools have lost nearly 70,000 students since 2013 — more than one in nine of the students they used to teach. That is the equivalent of the entire population of Gulfport disappearing from the public school system in little over a decade. Most districts have seen their numbers fall, and a few by as much as 40 percent.

Where do you suppose the kids have gone? Is it demographics?

No. Over the same period that K-12 enrollment in Mississippi has collapsed, the number of students enrolled in Mississippi's public universities has grown. If it were simply a case of there being fewer young people in our state, our universities would be shrinking too. They are not. In aggregate, they are expanding, pulling in more students from out of state.

The fall in K-12 student numbers is not due to a lack of students. It is caused by the fact that families are choosing alternatives for their kids.
---
|
---
_School choice – it’s happening_
| What has happened at the site of the old Chastain Middle School is a microcosm of what is happening across the state. Families are voting with their feet, looking for alternatives to the one-size-fits-all, zip-code-allocated school down the road.

But here's the kicker. Jackson Public Schools, which has lost an estimated 13,000 pupils since 2013 — roughly half its student body — spends an estimated $14,275 per student per year. Small private schools will typically do it for about half that amount.

In other words, the public school system has been hemorrhaging students despite spending more per student than the average private school in the state.

What if we were to allow any family that wanted to attend a Redeemer-type school to do so, using some of the money their school board already receives?

At the moment, the state of Mississippi spends a base amount of around $7,000 per child in public funding — plus variable amounts on top of that under the new funding formula.

If each family were able to direct their share of state funding to the school of their choice, it would suddenly make schools like Redeemer's affordable to families who today could never dream of sending their child there. And it would encourage many more Redeemers to spring up across our state.

"But my local school board is excellent," I hear you interject. "The school where I live is really good."

I am sure you are right. There are plenty of first-class school boards and plenty of excellent schools.

But the raw data on plummeting enrollment tells us that not every family is happy with their zip-code options.

The plummeting enrollment numbers don't surprise me. The only thing that does is the way certain fake ‘conservative’ politicians continue to insist that families must take the zip-code options they are given.

During the recent legislative session, for example, several lawmakers told me they opposed school choice because they feared a flood of new children pouring into their local public schools — despite knowing full well that school boards can cap enrollment. One or two claimed that school choice would drain resources from public schools — despite the math showing it simply would not.

I no longer believe many of those opposed to school choice in the legislature really believe such arguments. They are excuse arguments, made by people who have chosen to side with school superintendents determined to keep control, rather than with parents. They cite these arguments to justify siding with the education bureaucracy.

At MCPP, we will be doubling down as we point this out. We need more Redeemers!

Those running for public office who oppose parents wanting more choices for their kids can be called all sorts of things. 'Conservative' is not one of them.
---
|
---
_Texas Republicans opposed to school choice got primaried._
| [Forward this email to a friend!](https://us.list-manage.com/MWA6WhcXNsV?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3 "Forward this email to a friend!")
---
| |
---
Warm regards,

Douglas Carswell
President & CEO
Mississippi Center for Public Policy

Peter,
We can expand the Supreme Court by adding more Justices. Rebalance it. Take it back from the extremists who have captured it.
A Democratic majority that controls the House, the Senate, and the White House simultaneously can do it. The Constitution does not set the number of justices. Congress has changed it seven times in American history. No constitutional amendment required.
What is required is a movement so loud, so organized, and so relentless that when Democrats take power, court reform is not a debate--it is a mandate.

We launched that movement last week. Today it goes into full force. Unpack Our Courts is not a petition. It is not a hashtag. It is a multi-cycle political operation.
Here is what we are building:

* The public case -- polling, messaging, and earned media to make SCOTUS reform a defining issue of 2026 and 2028, connected to every Senate race, every House race, every voter who lost something when this court made its choices.

* The donor coalition -- the network of major and grassroots donors who will fund the most expensive constitutional fight in modern American political history across multiple election cycles.

* The political pressure -- direct engagement with Democratic candidates and officeholders to make court reform a litmus test, not a seminar topic. As Ro Khanna said: the next Democratic White House does not need a commission. It needs action.

* The grassroots army -- built from the 96,249 donors (and growing) who helped us win in Pennsylvania and Wisconsin, expanded into a national movement that makes the chorus for reform impossible to ignore.

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

We are officially ONE MONTH OUT from the New York Democratic primaries —
and we have the chance to build on New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani’s
victory by sending two bold Justice Democrats to Congress to fight for
working-class New Yorkers.

In the crowded race for NY-07’s open seat, State Assemblymember Claire
Valdez is running as a proud democratic socialist, union organizer, and
fighter for working people. She’s spent her career organizing workers,
defending tenants, and pushing to tax the rich — and now she’s up against
the same corporate interests that constantly try to crush candidates who
threaten the status quo.

Then, in NY-13, Justice Democrats-recruited organizer Darializa Avila
Chevalier is taking on one of the most entrenched Democratic incumbents in
the House: corporate- and AIPAC-backed Rep. Adriano Espaillat. As a
working-class Afro-Latina organizer, UAW member, and daughter of Dominican
immigrants, Darializa spent years fighting for immigrant communities,
against family separation, and for justice in upper Manhattan and the
Bronx.

They’re both relying on grassroots supporters like you,
Peter, because they believe
working people deserve representatives who answer to their communities —
not billionaires, corporations, or lobbyists.

That’s exactly why these races matter.

The only way to transform the Democratic Party is by electing bold
progressives like Claire and Darializa: leaders willing to fight for
affordable housing, stronger unions, healthcare as a human right, and
dignity for all people.

subject: Ohioans deserve answers.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Shontel Brown for Congress
body:
Secretary Frank LaRose has decided to expose Ohio voters to unnecessary risks.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/131941647/622846673/-153530995?refcode=EM_C_260522answers_N_SB_90DO_5_NG_N_LOGO&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzg0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMmI4OWY2NC1hOTU2LWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UYyyh9MteyxHfSgh0L59ReU-zGHmT8wZm_DKeDJI68E=) Peter,

Recently, I joined Ohio’s Democratic members of Congress in sending a letter to Ohio’s Secretary of State demanding answers about his decision to turn over sensitive voter information of nearly 8 million Ohioans to the Trump administration.

Most states have declined these demands to protect voters because of the breadth of information requested, the lack of transparency on _why_ or how it will be used, and Trump’s blatant calls to nationalize elections and weaponize Americans’ data. However, Secretary Frank LaRose has decided to expose Ohio voters to unnecessary risks – misuse, unauthorized access, leaks, and identity theft.

**This action could jeopardize Ohioans’ fundamental right to vote with no safeguards in place – and the people deserve answers.**

These threats are not theoretical. Disturbing reports have surfaced showing the DHS reaching out to Ohio counties to demand personal information on voters under the pretext of investigating election fraud. **This is part of a dangerous, expanding effort to aggregate our sensitive data without transparency and legal precedent.**

This is just another example of the Trump administration attacking our democracy, and Secretary of State LaRose’s eagerness to comply is deeply concerning. It’s our duty to ensure personal information and our right to vote are protected.

In solidarity,

Shontel Brown | Shontel Brown is proud to be elected as the Congresswoman for Ohio’s 11th District. She has spent the last decade serving the people of Ohio and building coalitions. As she enters her second full term in Congress, she will use that experience to continue the fight for affordable quality health care, jobs that pay fair wages, a strong public education system, and to preserve and protect our democracy for generations to come. Will you join her and be the change we need?

name: Major General Paul Eaton, U.S. Army, retired
subject: Some thoughts before Memorial Day
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTEVETS, VOTEVETS
body:
As Trump threatens to send another generation of our best to war, the work we do at VoteVets is more important than it ever has been.
#
Peter, Monday is Memorial Day.
I led the Army Infantry Center and School at Fort Benning from 2001 until 2003. I watched our best young men and women pass through that school, and many of them went on to fight in Iraq and Afghanistan. Nearly 7000 Americans were killed in those wars, and more than 22,000 took their own lives after they came home.
Those honored dead are never far from my mind, as is my father. Norman Dale Eaton and his co-pilot Paul Getchell were shot down over Laos in 1969, and their remains didn’t make it home until 2006. They rest at Arlington National Cemetery now, surrounded by comrades. Memorial Day is for them, their families, and all those who died so our nation might live.
As Trump threatens to send another generation of our best to war, the work we do at VoteVets is more important than it ever has been. We have the opportunity to prevent that, and we can’t let it slip away.

subject: What she saw on the ultrasound changed everything
body:
But an ultrasound changes that. When a mother sees her baby on the screen and hears the heartbeat, fear is interrupted with truth.

| | | | [](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkc2q3DAMhZ_G2c2QSHF-FlmUhkAX01IKt8ugsZXE4NjGdjKvX3KZ-wDdSTqHT0jn72N-kLHGrT9p50GdZo5pfm2U08aJXt7ljQ-bIyV_OD1DCc2tlDfAy1cVelC6QSh4qNq2lzX22BbboJanbPRC0HVLV7aAqq9JLij7p-pRNYUZLlIpASusJcr7UkvWGjvoe8VUsajLI2jKnO7Ku8TxpGxONs75q_Lurvxe2GHLOSSB3wRMAqbVnHwPkZ8-fhoETO9OwEQhMNkkcEpK4Pj4VUpo_jwqAQ3tWeAInYBmTQJHcgKaI-9z8kdULHAM0afAKhu3vqWdtTl2gSPvZOx7qGgPZFYncIxMdrZm4S_Ju8zu2vMB8-_29v3jx-3rCUUcdHgZa01qWlGX64X8vDD_fybnAP8CAAD__x_Emsw)
---
Natally never thought she would become a mother. As a child, she had been told she couldn’t have children, and after years of trying during marriage, she eventually accepted that reality. But in 2023, after walking through divorce, addiction recovery, and one of the hardest seasons of her life, she stared down at a positive pregnancy test in complete shock. “I didn’t tell anyone,” Natally shared. “I felt so alone at that time.” Fear quickly took over. The father of the baby did not want to be involved, and Natally became overwhelmed by the thought of raising a child completely on her own. Though she had been raised in church, she admitted that for the first time in her life, abortion crossed her mind. “If I don’t go through with this,” she thought, “all the criticism will come back. If I do, no one will ever know.” [**Then an old coworker told her about a PreBorn! Network Clinic.**](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkc2q3DAMhZ_G2c2QSHF-FlmUhkAX01IKt8ugsZXE4NjGdjKvX3KZ-wDdSTqHT0jn72N-kLHGrT9p50GdZo5pfm2U08aJXt7ljQ-bIyV_OD1DCc2tlDfAy1cVelC6QSh4qNq2lzX22BbboJanbPRC0HVLV7aAqq9JLij7p-pRNYUZLlIpASusJcr7UkvWGjvoe8VUsajLI2jKnO7Ku8TxpGxONs75q_Lurvxe2GHLOSSB3wRMAqbVnHwPkZ8-fhoETO9OwEQhMNkkcEpK4Pj4VUpo_jwqAQ3tWeAInYBmTQJHcgKaI-9z8kdULHAM0afAKhu3vqWdtTl2gSPvZOx7qGgPZFYncIxMdrZm4S_Ju8zu2vMB8-_29v3jx-3rCUUcdHgZa01qWlGX64X8vDD_fybnAP8CAAD__x_Emsw) Natally walked into the Clinic carrying fear, shame, uncertainty, and the weight of everything she had been through. But instead of judgment, she found compassion. Someone listened to her, held her hand, and reminded her that her story was not over. Then came the ultrasound. Natally admitted she was terrified. “I refused, at first, to even look at it (the screen),” she said. “It was the hardest thing.” But when she finally looked up, she saw something she says she will never forget. **“The sac she was in was heart-shaped,”** Natally**shared. “I felt like it was God giving me peace.”** That moment changed everything. Today, Natally’s daughter is thriving after surviving an extremely premature birth at just 24 weeks. Natally calls her daughter “my miracle” and “my medicine.” Friend, stories like Natally’s are why PreBorn! exists. Right now, women across the country are walking into abortion facilities believing they have no other choice but to end their pregnancies. Many feel overwhelmed, afraid, pressured, or completely alone.
---
[](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkc2q3DAMhZ_G2c2QSHF-FlmUhkAX01IKt8ugsZXE4NjGdjKvX3KZ-wDdSTqHT0jn72N-kLHGrT9p50GdZo5pfm2U08aJXt7ljQ-bIyV_OD1DCc2tlDfAy1cVelC6QSh4qNq2lzX22BbboJanbPRC0HVLV7aAqq9JLij7p-pRNYUZLlIpASusJcr7UkvWGjvoe8VUsajLI2jKnO7Ku8TxpGxONs75q_Lurvxe2GHLOSSB3wRMAqbVnHwPkZ8-fhoETO9OwEQhMNkkcEpK4Pj4VUpo_jwqAQ3tWeAInYBmTQJHcgKaI-9z8kdULHAM0afAKhu3vqWdtTl2gSPvZOx7qGgPZFYncIxMdrZm4S_Ju8zu2vMB8-_29v3jx-3rCUUcdHgZa01qWlGX64X8vDD_fybnAP8CAAD__x_Emsw)
---

Ken Paxton | From: Ken Paxton To: dpwillis67@gmail.com Date: May 19, 2026 Subject: Breaking: President Trump Has Endorsed Me | | | Friend, I'm excited and so pleased to share that just a few minutes ago, President Trump endorsed me in my Senate race. I truly appreciate his full and complete endorsement of my campaign. Thank you, President Trump! I have always been a proud supporter of President Trump, and I have worked hard every day to put America First in all that I do as Texas Attorney General. As you know, Friend, not all Republicans have embraced the America First agenda, nor have all Republicans stayed true to the conservative movement and the issues that grassroots conservatives care about... subject: What she saw on the ultrasound changed everything
body:
But an ultrasound changes that. When a mother sees her baby on the screen and hears the heartbeat, fear is interrupted with truth.

| | | | [](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkc2umzAQhZ9m2CWyx4CTBYtKiF1a9UftEg1mAKvGtmxz8_oVV8kDdDlzjr7Rp_nzGB9knfXrV9q5S2UZUx6fG5W8caZn8GXjw5VEORx-HlFgexHNBdXZk9XczWYmaSrupNb3pq5vt6baurkWjaAal7vWs1CTarXRhFOthGI2VNnuRIkGlayFRHkVLCcU7f1GcjK61VALcpzKNXE8JmcN-UL57xKS4asJe-W6rZSYQX0BHACH1X7wNSaeQvJnAXB4TYADxcjkMqghG1D945tosP35kIAt7QVUjzfAds2gevKA7VH2MYcjGQbVxxRyZFOsX1_RzrM9dlA972Tda2loj2RXD6pPTG50duF3FHxhf975jeN3ffnxa7i8_avUzfFpnbP503o9kZ-G5f__8dHhvwAAAP__Y8CYWQ)
---
Natally never thought she would become a mother. As a child, she had been told she couldn’t have children, and after years of trying during marriage, she eventually accepted that reality. But in 2023, after walking through divorce, addiction recovery, and one of the hardest seasons of her life, she stared down at a positive pregnancy test in complete shock. “I didn’t tell anyone,” Natally shared. “I felt so alone at that time.” Fear quickly took over. The father of the baby did not want to be involved, and Natally became overwhelmed by the thought of raising a child completely on her own. Though she had been raised in church, she admitted that for the first time in her life, abortion crossed her mind. “If I don’t go through with this,” she thought, “all the criticism will come back. If I do, no one will ever know.” [**Then an old coworker told her about a PreBorn! Network Clinic.**](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkc2umzAQhZ9m2CWyx4CTBYtKiF1a9UftEg1mAKvGtmxz8_oVV8kDdDlzjr7Rp_nzGB9knfXrV9q5S2UZUx6fG5W8caZn8GXjw5VEORx-HlFgexHNBdXZk9XczWYmaSrupNb3pq5vt6baurkWjaAal7vWs1CTarXRhFOthGI2VNnuRIkGlayFRHkVLCcU7f1GcjK61VALcpzKNXE8JmcN-UL57xKS4asJe-W6rZSYQX0BHACH1X7wNSaeQvJnAXB4TYADxcjkMqghG1D945tosP35kIAt7QVUjzfAds2gevKA7VH2MYcjGQbVxxRyZFOsX1_RzrM9dlA972Tda2loj2RXD6pPTG50duF3FHxhf975jeN3ffnxa7i8_avUzfFpnbP503o9kZ-G5f__8dHhvwAAAP__Y8CYWQ) Natally walked into the Clinic carrying fear, shame, uncertainty, and the weight of everything she had been through. But instead of judgment, she found compassion. Someone listened to her, held her hand, and reminded her that her story was not over. Then came the ultrasound. Natally admitted she was terrified. “I refused, at first, to even look at it (the screen),” she said. “It was the hardest thing.” But when she finally looked up, she saw something she says she will never forget. **“The sac she was in was heart-shaped,”** Natally**shared. “I felt like it was God giving me peace.”** That moment changed everything. Today, Natally’s daughter is thriving after surviving an extremely premature birth at just 24 weeks. Natally calls her daughter “my miracle” and “my medicine.” Friend, stories like Natally’s are why PreBorn! exists. Right now, women across the country are walking into abortion facilities believing they have no other choice but to end their pregnancies.
