| | | Friend,
---
For years, the Left thought they had a permanent grip on America's youth.

And honestly?

For a while, they did.
They dominated classrooms. Social media. Pop culture. Hollywood. Universities.

They told an entire generation that loving your country was shameful...

That faith was outdated... And traditional values were something to erase.

But thanks to Charlie's leadership, something incredible has happened:

Young men are rejecting the Left in RECORD numbers. High school boys are the most Conservative they've been in 50 years.

And Gen Z is heading back to church -- in numbers greater than their parents' or grandparents' generations.

For the first time in decades, we are WINNING the American Culture War.

**But there 's still one group the Left is desperately fighting to hold onto: **

_America 's young women. _

Because they know something very important, Friend...

If they can win the hearts and minds of young women...

They don't just shape individuals. They shape families. They shape homes. They shape future generations.

**And that 's exactly why Turning Point USA's Women's Leadership Summit (WLS) matters more than ever this year. **
---

I've spent the last 7 years helping lead the team behind Turning Point USA's biggest events.

And I can honestly tell you:

I've never seen young women hungrier for truth, purpose, faith, wellness, and real community than they are right now.

Because modern culture is failing them.

The Left sold them confusion and called it "empowerment."

They told young women: femininity is weakness, motherhood is oppression, faith is foolish, patriotism is toxic, and healthy living is extremism.

And after years of hearing those lies...

So many young women feel exhausted. Lonely. Anxious. Spiritually empty.

They're searching for something REAL.

Somewhere they can breathe again. Somewhere they can grow stronger instead of being torn down.

_That 's what Women's Leadership Summit has become. _

Not just another event... but a place where thousands of women come together to rediscover truth, confidence, purpose, and courage.

**From June 5 -7 in San Antonio, women from across the country will gather to: **

✅ Strengthen their minds
✅ Cultivate wellness
✅ Step boldly into their purpose
✅ Anchor their spirits in faith

And when they walk into that room... _Something changes. _

Friend, I see it happen every year -- and from backstage, you can actually watch the change happen in real time.

Young women arriving unsure of themselves...

_Then leaving with fire in their eyes. _

Women who thought they were alone suddenly realizing:

_" There are thousands of other women who love God, love Freedom, and LOVE AMERICA just like I do." _

That matters.

Because the Left wants these young women isolated.

Disconnected. Demoralized. Easy to manipulate.

But WLS reminds them they are part of something MUCH bigger.

**A movement. A sisterhood. A generation of strong, patriotic women rising up to reject the lies they 've been fed for years. **

And these women don't just leave inspired... _They go home ready to LEAD. _

I've watched women leave WLS and:

🔥 Strengthen their faith
🔥 Embrace their femininity
🔥 Build friendships rooted in truth and purpose
🔥 Boldly speak out on their campuses
🔥 Launch Turning Point USA chapters
🔥 Lead in their communities and in this movement

This is how we WIN the culture war. One fearless young woman at a time.

clean_body: We cannot surrender young women to the Left For years, the Left thought they had a permanent grip on America's youth. | | | | | | | Friend, For years, the Left thought they had a permanent grip on America's youth. And honestly? For a while, they did. They dominated classrooms. Social media. Pop culture. Hollywood. Universities. They told an entire generation that loving your country was shameful... That faith was outdated... And traditional values were something to erase. But thanks to Charlie's leadership, something incredible has happened: Young men are rejecting the Left in RECORD numbers. High school boys are the most Conservative they've been in 50 years. And Gen Z is heading back to church -- in numbers greater than their parents' or grandparents' generations. For the first time in decades, we are WINNING the American Culture War. But there 's still one group the Left is desperately fighting to hold onto: America 's young women. Because they know something very important, Friend... If they can win the hearts and minds of young women... They don't just shape individuals. They shape families. They shape homes. They shape future generations. And that 's exactly why Turning Point USA's Women's Leadership Summit (WLS) matters more than ever this year. I've spent the last 7 years helping lead the team behind Turning Point USA's biggest events. And I can honestly tell you: I've never seen young women hungrier for truth, purpose, faith, wellness, and real community than they are right now. Because modern culture is failing them. The Left sold them confusion and called it "empowerment." They told young women: femininity is weakness, motherhood is oppression, faith is foolish, patriotism is toxic, and healthy living is extremism. And after years of hearing those lies... So many young women feel exhausted. Lonely. Anxious. Spiritually empty. They're searching for something REAL. Somewhere they can breathe again. Somewhere they can grow stronger instead of being torn down. That 's what Women's Leadership Summit has become. Not just another event... but a place where thousands of women come together to rediscover truth, confidence, purpose, and courage. From June 5 -7 in San Antonio, women from across the country will gather to: ✅ Strengthen their minds ✅ Cultivate wellness ✅ Step boldly into their purpose ✅ Anchor their spirits in faith And when they walk into that room... Something changes. Friend, I see it happen every year -- and from backstage, you can actually watch the change happen in real time. Young women arriving unsure of themselves... Then leaving with fire in their eyes. Women who thought they were alone suddenly realizing: " There are thousands of other women who love God, love Freedom, and LOVE AMERICA just like I do." That matters. Because the Left wants these young women isolated. Disconnected. Demoralized. Easy to manipulate. But WLS reminds them they are part of something MUCH bigger. A movement. A sisterhood. A generation of strong, patriotic women rising up to reject the lies they 've been fed for years. And these women don't just leave inspired... They go home ready to LEAD. I've watched women leave WLS and: 🔥 Strengthen their faith 🔥 Embrace their femininity 🔥 Build friendships rooted in truth and purpose 🔥 Boldly speak out on their campuses 🔥 Launch Turning Point USA chapters 🔥 Lead in their communities and in this movement This is how we WIN the culture war. One fearless young woman at a time. But here 's the problem, Friend... Right now, we have many young women who desperately want to attend WLS but may miss this life-changing experience without help. Some are students working to save enough money for gas or airfare. Others are trapped in environments where they constantly feel pressured to stay silent about their beliefs. And many just need ONE place where they can be surrounded by women who will encourage them, strengthen them, and remind them they were created for MORE. But there 's not much time left before the doors open... I truly believe Women's Leadership Summit can change the trajectory of a young woman's life... That's why I'm personally asking: For many young women, attending WLS is the moment everything starts to change. The moment they realize they are NOT alone. The moment they stop apologizing for loving God, loving freedom, and loving America. The moment they begin stepping boldly into the life and purpose they were created for. Because if we want to save this country... We MUST reach America 's young women before the Left does. That's the mission. And I believe with all my heart that the Women's Leadership Summit is a launching pad for the future mothers, leaders, creators, and culture-shapers who will determine where this country goes next. body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Did you see our ad exposing Rep. Doris Matsui’s record?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260523-mv.J1HCIy&refcode=em20260523-37814&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=37814%2E1203867%2Eh71asr ]Tweet by Ryan Grim: Justice Democrats, fresh off the Chris Rabb
victory, is putting $150k behind an ad hitting incumbent Doris Matsui for
being pro-ICE and pro-Israel. Her challenger Mai Vang was on Breaking
Points this morning. [Screenshot of ad saying “After all these years,
Doris Matsui is still letting us down”]

Here’s the truth. Rep. Matsui:

* Takes money from ICE contractors and AIPAC;
* Voted for billions more for Trump’s ICE budget;
* Voted for billions more in weapons to Israel;
* And voted for Trump’s agenda, selling working families out.

This is exactly what’s wrong with the corporate-backed Democratic
establishment.

For years, Do-Nothing Democrats like Rep. Matsui have given us lip service
in speeches and on the campaign trail — and then turned around and voted
with corporate interests and the far right when it mattered most.

That’s exactly why Justice Democrats endorsed Mai Vang for CA-07.

Mai is a community organizer, educator, and Sacramento city councilmember
who knows what this moment demands: fighting for the working class.

She supports abolishing ICE, ending military aid to Israel, and passing
Medicare for All and a Green New Deal.

And unlike Rep. Doris Matsui, Mai isn’t funded by the same interests
profiting off of deportations, war, and corporate greed.

This primary election is in less than two weeks. Keeping our ad on the air
could make the difference between being stuck with an out-of-touch,
corporate-backed Democrat in Congress — or replacing her with a real
progressive like Mai.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260523-mv.J1HCIy&refcode=em20260523-37814&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1003&akid=37814%2E1203867%2Eh71asr ]Will you split a $10 donation between Mai’s campaign and
Justice Democrats to keep this ad running and reach as many voters as
possible between now and June 2?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260523-mv.J1HCIy&refcode=em20260523-37814&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1022&akid=37814%2E1203867%2Eh71asr ]Contribute $10

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

name: Senator Tim Sheehy
subject: An absolute insult to every veteran
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Collins for Senator
body:
I’m confident we didn’t learn this in basic training.

| [](https://trk.email.goprelease._HYQ)
---
Peter,
Tim Sheehy here. Former Navy SEAL and conservative Republican.
I must have missed the day in basic training where they taught us to get Nazi tattoos and say women deserved to be raped.
But apparently, Graham Platner thinks he can blame his time in the military for his vile Reddit posts and his Nazi tattoo.
Let me be clear: no veteran is taught these things in the service. It is an absolute insult to every man and woman who wore the uniform that he just shrugs his shoulders and uses the military as an excuse for his own sick behavior.
We cannot let radical, unhinged individuals like this get anywhere near the levers of power. The stakes for our country are too high, and the far-left machine is turning a blind eye to this madness.
I am stepping up to put a stop to this, but I cannot do it alone. You have the power to shut this down, but we are running out of time.
[Can you please chip in today to help us fight back against this radical nonsense and defend our conservative values before midnight?](https://trk.email.goprelease._qNALLYKnA)

Hi friend,
I’ve spent this month traveling across Southwest Colorado on our By the People Tour — meeting with voters in Grand Junction, Carbondale, Pueblo West, Pagosa Springs, Durango, Dolores, Telluride, and Ridgway.

Peter,
---
It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 _ _ and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. **But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250****th**** birthday.**
---
[](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=e344c530e2ae45c098a3198eb629059c&_e=ELv1MqRd9prAa3YjPCYmk0mEjxRwcURkRgVU0B667Hrv5_WV8rCGnihSXUWtbWLX4mNELABSLwZub8mZcjJYnp7BJ0C47q3BzNM6_9-weoRzBRmX7ZKHDPJkTPpN2fent3bOEyx1I4cO67wA6tTqxEFmvVe1dHnNq6lqnyY710eRjFXpPs2bPaKcu8evyHi4OkZ_mIEwjme5tm_QTBkhgpt17YCocnsqWm9ODs1Dx9LMRCunfibVwM_BXSY3ob9psm62RqKi1Y94Onvnr3NtVBMHuVEralkVz4SxcKQ9HQOQGl7IXluPUmYV77jvkDAn6d1EunNmM24_uatXwk6VFXr7SmaR6hCkDd4T21KnEchW2OEFNXABJNhQLuTz9LOGUXR_8jK8Tk7Wuk6HuvqTzt1ztPy3uChat8DiE08LujvdPM50Ai4cCRr1Zf-n8QX1Ut5sY-fNcZJSHyIYXPwdODS3YloQL0p5hq3sBAJLg45QXTx4hBzLBhbk6DcsP3lrGTgvBYMcFDMdbyMe-URlLGRL4C1Fdx0cZXzi0xvNyJQ73de5pRQV9z4dG9SeZhSH5j7u1Y4GAw27vrmaXLZofQHgobgiW5AoPrh8yPxcxORjqSAi3BqaB3QJWgcqZLhlX_V5LURiFbgju0ym8qyJLZs852LQiubEx87MuCeRWlVHv3aEIFQdI69cEKkgT2tO)

Peter, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. **Peter, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you.** **[In light of America’s 250th birthday and the special opportunity we have to honor veterans this year, will you chip in today to help support the parade with a gift of $25, $50, $75, $150, or more?](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=e344c530e2ae45c098a3198eb629059c&_e=ELv1MqRd9prAa3YjPCYmk0mEjxRwcURkRgVU0B667Hrv5_WV8rCGnihSXUWtbWLX4mNELABSLwZub8mZcjJYnp7BJ0C47q3BzNM6_9-weoRzBRmX7ZKHDPJkTPpN2fent3bOEyx1I4cO67wA6tTqxEFmvVe1dHnNq6lqnyY710eRjFXpPs2bPaKcu8evyHi4OkZ_mIEwjme5tm_QTBkhgpt17YCocnsqWm9ODs1Dx9LMRCunfibVwM_BXSY3ob9pBuvFW9QmXlQYOCM2RPwryp-8t8hEppy_pXDLSDc5RK-67EFFI5keq6sVGno9I7biTUG7JEq6x0Rk4hZe0OnTz_v7DOTN1TAxcIs3ciKifIby-9vE6yCKsAn0ZB8jSsVfQTj9hLEAjEGdB_9YOC2kIpJW21UE8AgbzOTV5GN47REan-R72_ak6U8NdBsVkHQOiIrH_SeDB4BtYBMCsRzi0BfwMDtjbNkhzYJwvP2kET1cgKydbvqFKFTm5d_7uG1X8CijOQmU8d6kpa95FVuIifCnnd2X0myszWcln9wwTjRrVwJpCEUX6gfasNlgSANUi3JXPnCf-9hAUOBrHQERUTt-E05l9ZRjFCyAOi5uoWZx0wOxJTzoD1qlSJlGnNHZ5Vnkjgm91pxC115quhrIXQLJDrC3oveWFI1xG4Avii31OYQYWGP2dY0QUbPr5b1W)**

The 2026 National Memorial Day Parade is a once-in-a-lifetime moment where we need to do all we can to honor our country and our veterans. _Bigger_ crowds. _More_ veterans. _More _young people learning what courage, service, and sacrifice really mean.
---
[](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=e344c530e2ae45c098a3198eb629059c&_e=ELv1MqRd9prAa3YjPCYmk0mEjxRwcURkRgVU0B667Hrv5_WV8rCGnihSXUWtbWLX4mNELABSLwZub8mZcjJYnp7BJ0C47q3BzNM6_9-weoRzBRmX7ZKHDPJkTPpN2fent3bOEyx1I4cO67wA6tTqxEFmvVe1dHnNq6lqnyY710eRjFXpPs2bPaKcu8evyHi4OkZ_mIEwjme5tm_QTBkhgpt17YCocnsqWm9ODs1Dx9LMRCunfibVwM_BXSY3ob9pNdqvC--CSMUZtGRM_Jew2Qg3ogdy7JgRsmoGKYALbJUY0FlgAvUIzyABL6tWxYoixoLzK2yFu61V_fwgAV1qGE_N1pBPZBKfG_9h0Ksj9Q6My_xec1qrpevmXUIlk-ehr8ucj1ENusct5_7mzEqmMaayG94o6nFY07LIzUNsH3_3KPJu85kPUaBjGSa8fgCnLKycaXmYnJuG3W1bBfKy1l_8MZieMZT9hGZjkQnB4sIsFNqtqxuEBOfDKDBF_lX_8mvCnJh5jktZX1firt1ksxqYjeh-MxIgf3Gnl78rfTHVOM4vRGUE5MOqRZaT5NPFyFJINb5SJiTAMuKccgp3uDFpbWPg1dXGDd7dJmMJgdSumLyNtcFLncQyO_926SNNzkTLr3pS2Zxt4wQNg41HTOynbGs3gYmX2Z77-Md5IgLeVby_W_WSb21qDLu9LA5-)
---

clean_body: We must honor them while we can| | | Peter, It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250th birthday. Peter, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. Peter, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you. The 2026 National Memorial Day Parade is a once-in-a-lifetime moment where we need to do all we can to honor our country and our veterans. Bigger crowds. More veterans. More young people learning what courage, service, and sacrifice really mean. - Historically, AVC has been able to do this at a fraction of what other major public events cost to put on each year. In fact, the entire parade costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl Parade! That means that every dollar that's contributed by a generous American like you makes a difference for this important event. But I want to reiterate that American Veterans Center does not take ANY federal funding for this event. It is funded entirely by private citizens like you who want to honor those who have sacrificed so much for our country. | | Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the parade, but also supports great programs like: Record hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to today before we lose these stories forever. Hold our annual American Veterans Conference, which allows young cadets a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, Vietnam, and our modern wars. Produce veteran-focused T.V. documentaries and specials that remind Americans the price of our freedom. But of course, the National Memorial Day Parade is AVC's flagship event honoring America's veterans. And this year's parade will be the largest in their history of hosting the parade. If you've been looking for an opportunity to give back to those who have given so much for our freedom, this is one of the best possible ways you could do it. And for a special group of veterans, this might be one of the last chances we get. You see, with each year that goes by, we lose more and more of our World War II veterans, and for the few we have remaining, traveling to Washington, D.C., for the parade is difficult. | | | | | WWII veterans were a key part of the first parade when it was revived in 2005, as they have been every year since for the last 20 years. But this may be the last year we have the opportunity to have these brave men and women with us for the parade. This year is a rare moment when living witnesses to World War II and America 's 250**th birthday overlap. And no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you. On Memorial Day - not just this momentous year of military milestones, but every year - please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. Visit a local veterans' cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. I believe that while we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, we can always do a little more. Peter, thank you for your support of America 's heroes. Sincerely, Gary Sinise Honarary Grand MarshalNational Memorial Day Parade P.S. Peter, America is stepping into its 250th year, and this Memorial Day begins that national remembrance. Veterans across generations have given their lives to defend America and all she stands for. And for the Greatest Generation in particular, this may be the last time they're able to join us at this year's National Memorial Day Parade. Hi, I know you get a lot of emails from me. So I wanted to
take a step back and tell you a little bit more about me and why I’m
running to be the next Governor of Michigan.

Ever since I was a student, I knew I wanted to fight for justice and make
a difference. I’m the daughter of two special education teachers. I was
raised in a working class family that instilled in me the values of hard
work, opportunity, and serving others.

It’s why I started my career investigating threats to democracy and civil
rights in the US and abroad.

It’s why I became a law clerk in Detroit, fighting to protect and defend
people’s civil rights and freedoms.

It’s why, as Dean of Wayne State University Law School, I worked to ensure
all students could afford their education, froze tuition, and expanded
scholarships.

And it’s why, as Secretary of State, I’ve fought to make everyday life
easier for all Michiganders, secure our elections, and expand voter
access.

But I know our work is far from finished. So now, I’m running for Governor
to make sure Michigan is a place where everyone – from our kids to our
seniors – can stay and thrive.

I know that government works best when it’s there when you need it, and
gets out of the way when you don’t. So here’s my promise to you: when we
win this election, I will use every tool available to make life easier:
expand rural healthcare options, build more housing, take on the utility
companies who raise our rates, make childcare free, and ensure anyone can
afford to live in the best place to call home.

But here’s the truth: Michigan is one of the most competitive states in
the entire country, and our opponents have the backing of big billionaires
and special interests. I can only win this race with your support, so

body:
But now, my final trial awaits...
| Peter,
---
I fell into a coma. I was put on a ventilator. I was given my last rites.
---
But by the grace of God and the power of _YOUR_ prayers...
---
**_...I’M BACK!_**
---
I’m a _fighter_ to my core – and now I’m 100% recovered and ready to win the FINAL BATTLE for my freedom against a vengeful Democrat Attorney General who wants to **IMPRISON** me for _20 YEARS_!
---
**A coma couldn’t take me down. Neither will this bloodthirsty left-wing prosecutor!**
---
During my coma, I had a deeply spiritual experience.
---
Humbly, I cannot say I was headed straight for heaven. Rather, it felt like I was headed to a trial by St. Peter where all my life’s deeds were put on display.
---
That moment put everything in perspective.
---
**No matter what happens in my RIGGED TRIAL in Arizona, the ONLY trial that ultimately matters is the one before God.**
---
**_And I can say with absolute confidence that when I was tested, I chose to stand by my principles – even if it meant getting _ARRESTED_ ... TWICE!_**
---
So, just as I’ve fought the Mafia, the Deep State, countless witch hunts, and now _even a coma_ , I will fight this rigged case against me – and WIN!
---
**_But to win, I’m going to need the best defense I can get. Just as I heavily relied on your prayers, I’m honestly going to need your support to secure a top-notch defense to beat a left-wing prosecutor hell-bent on throwing me in prison._**

**********************
The TTV Weekly Wrap Up
**********************

It’s been a wild week — feels like both a marathon and a sprint. Here we go...

Questions surrounding transparency, accountability, redistricting, and election administration continue to intensify, while at the same time, Americans gathered in Washington, D.C. to rededicate the nation to God, 250 years after the first national call to prayer during the Revolutionary War. The battle for America’s future isn’t happening in just one arena. It’s unfolding nationwide in voting booths, courtrooms, state legislatures, election offices — and in the hearts and hands of Americans committed to preserving freedom for the next generation.

A quick note on Kentucky

We've been getting a lot of questions about Tuesday's Kentucky primary - specifically the Congressional District 4 race.

In 2022, the Republican primary in CD4 pulled around 67,000 votes. The 2024 presidential primary brought in roughly 53,000. Tuesday night? Turnout more than doubled by over 100,000 votes.

That's a serious jump. And here's another wrinkle: Massie, the incumbent, actually grew his vote total from last cycle. Normally that's a strong signal an incumbent is headed for reelection. He lost anyway. Very interesting

We'd love to dig in and see who these new voters are — when they registered, where they came from, whether anything looks off. The problem is Kentucky makes voter rolls incredibly challenging to obtain. Most states are easy; Kentucky isn't.

So this is an open ask: if you have access to post-primary voter roll data from Kentucky, please reach out to us. We'd love to dig in to the numbers.

---------
TTV in DC
---------

A few of us, along with friends and family members, had the honor to stand and worship amongst the hundreds of thousands in DC to rededicate this beautiful nation to God. In the blistering heat, we witnessed testimonies, every hand raised - young and old, and a unity we haven't experienced in decades. There were many tears. Tears of appreciation as we toured the National Archives, of laughter as we gathered as humans with one another, of joy as we broke bread, and of overwhelming gratitude for our Lord and Savior.

---------------
Until Next Week
---------------

Questions surrounding transparency, accountability, redistricting, and election administration continue to intensify, while at the same time, Americans gathered in Washington, D.C. to rededicate the nation to God, 250 years after the first national call to prayer during the Revolutionary War. The battle for America’s future isn’t happening in just one arena. It’s unfolding nationwide in voting booths, courtrooms, state legislatures, election offices — and in the hearts and hands of Americans committed to preserving freedom for the next generation. A quick note on Kentucky We've been getting a lot of questions about Tuesday's Kentucky primary - specifically the Congressional District 4 race. In 2022, the Republican primary in CD4 pulled around 67,000 votes. The 2024 presidential primary brought in roughly 53,000. Tuesday night? Turnout more than doubled by over 100,000 votes. That's a serious jump. And here's another wrinkle: Massie, the incumbent, actually grew his vote total from last cycle. Normally that's a strong signal an incumbent is headed for reelection. He lost anyway. Very interesting We'd love to dig in and see who these new voters are — when they registered, where they came from, whether anything looks off. The problem is Kentucky makes voter rolls incredibly challenging to obtain. Most states are easy; Kentucky isn't. **This is exactly the kind of power grab that EMILYs List was built to fight back against. **

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
How did Americans across the country, especially in the South, respond to the Supreme Court's decision to legally codify racial gerrymandering? They turned out in droves to march for their fundamental right to vote, folks.
For those of us who couldn't make it to Selma, Montgomery, or other places to march? We have to do everything we can to register a tidal wave of voters across the country.
Voter registration is a critical part of grassroots efforts to protect voting rights. The more people who vote, the more our government looks like we, the people. But to get to the point where every voice is heard, we need your help .
Every $3 chipped in can help us register a new voter. If you're with us in this fight, please pitch in $30 or whatever you can today to help register 10 new voters >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=052326_1&amount=30]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=052326_1&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=052326_1&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=052326_1&amount=50]

This was a devastating blow to voting rights, but it only serves to strengthen our resolve. If anti-voting forces are going to stack the deck against the communities we serve, then we will work even harder to engage and rally these voters, lift their voices, and defend their right to vote.
Despite vote-suppressing courts and state legislatures making it harder to register to vote -- passing bills to stop organizations like ours and our partners on the ground from helping potential voters navigate the increasingly murky rules around voter registration -- we're still pulling out all the stops to bring voters into the system.
Voter participation has been increasing. Voting quickly becomes a habit -- a habit our democracy sorely needs to fulfill the promise of the American dream. Overwhelming key states with new voter registrations can help turn the tide against the voter suppression laws we've seen passed the last few years.
This voter registration work, at just about $3 per new voter, is how we can make the greatest impact. Fuel our efforts with $30 to give us the resources we need to register new voters ahead of the 2026 deadlines >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=052326_1&amount=30]
Thank you,
Voter Action Project's Registration Team

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

My opponents have corporate PACs, billionaire donors, and special interests lining up behind them trying to buy influence in this state.

After that, the race moves on. | | A personal note from Steve | Before June 2nd ---|--- Dear Friend, I wrote this because I do not want this moment to pass quietly. You get a lot of campaign emails. I know that. Most of them are overly urgent and instantly forgettable. | | ★ | ---|---|--- Deadlines. Buttons. Exclamation points. The usual performance. This is not that. I wrote you a real note because June 2nd is almost here , and after that, this race moves on with us or without us. | Please read what I wrote | | There is no automatic Republican nominee in California. There is no second chance if we fall short. There is no clever explanation that will make up for failing to do everything possible while there was still time. That is the brutal, unavoidable fact. And frankly, I do not want this to be the last serious message I send to Americans across the country about this campaign because Democrats managed to stop us before November. That would be a bitter, ridiculous ending to a fight we can absolutely win. | Before the window closes Help me keep this campaign moving. | So before you scroll past another campaign email, I want you to read the note I wrote. I want to give you a picture of what's really happening right now -- not the polished version, but what it actually looks like on the ground.

Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible.
---
[](https://links.trueamericanconservatives.com/s/c/VIbj8kgE85GIJPJv-ApF_KZU6rqYG2yE1MENfrxXVxAW4XJfLCPmnn1ING2zTZ_ngnn_kEOPwhQXjnW2_SFeELQOCR4Ouy_uEEEHsbLbFLGScxI_sOJmrejEdiFOXSSY6HR7K_IHffJNmqqkfjFowjjCaIL2EeWiRHJ5RuykRB7gQpUul3OVA0m4IhCYaO6eSro_X-Rbxke4LIyILfZBUwHgdr9AKixwFANDz37opJrdWnWnGOWGislKxUL665KJZflO9Gjcd1OZ0j1SrGbmKPrRAC7K6j9BKX4z_SAUcIjBRdBeFGiE7THCFGBEFV5CgKzCtnVSlrXssMA2f62nFmc29FbZ5AqMN6RC4pvu_mKpkxmkTil4P1_upZ0SGA47X7SXd9-xqjQfueYiHdgWYYrKWvOKzUTSqMvJSnqL_RDu6qH24cAU-HqZ6DSQFCDGq8uaK4PGpk7koBK20vKIA4RkeujwSXQgamyNa4TxFQEziBIjyns3L5K2hvXIALRnkZ5cqAE2h_waI_zJfXccdCepdiNVcskSJNOAfYBTBL8C0izLe2LJBRC0-rOsoyy8vr2L-d43k4Ty5BvSSRT-45yRiezHLFFoVOO7Ru3qe9lIA4Vt1S4ZsEleyqMQ2ykSVVUfwBPKQ1OiWkpFBbXmkII4wK-GKE7rrQz416nsJEtPE9Vw4Fn8mKhDvzY2uE4j4qrdbcTaq3iO-aFiCa8G5kGvM3zACfWehuUhwXlWXgMrnggDdCQrwQwf6Q/lyU3VJ4Pjg4PgvQGRk8SZtLZUHe3oKVf/21)
---
_Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona_
---
These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them.

They're already claimed. And we don't have extras.

By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in.

Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it.

That's where things stand right now.

We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment.

And I don't say that lightly.

Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down.

The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing.

Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back.

**We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. **

For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there.

And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet.
---
[](https://links.trueamericanconservatives.com/s/c/yUZl3HzhMworWirywhRvtfHyRdaSr_8O8r9MmO3w8VBqN1c4-qIezPZ00VlUtubuP3VXFrNyldgawRirURyfrhPR7WtzDd7LdFMnbe0mrAt99bxzLJGaw-fQZEb44uxnsZJlSB51pnhrvD5QeUwaXFMiCDfjuZCpS7FN9hfo1KoGgUkt5mJj-U1StoRxAIGcWKF4iCkXXYcOcp720uuPG4E2nqqpIoU1jLLb0CAu-LDcioH3Z4vhmozkiLjoVRKgx7Z0g2siI-HbBbg-BLKeXuYy05XWiMdcBOZ5wIvOhGiJrvC_SlRzCBUuO_Lej4iCRNJtYoArTXoxetTovhB0idZ7VNApaW8Ttlbl2_oT9mHvxiA3VwxdLJXeG5AYYGB9Xy9D2-UOXTF03s0Jqq9PTRkYImD9HYrc9IRZGkd8zJzg3QrOBtxndEExWnsMU493_o6KLW_HTH7FdvD6mFLFZgtbT0Av1rUxQmu0yr0CCHaPRDQRF06Y5l_JeSerLGsvTk29oZ_O_HDvsnXPvPWDa9trshD5uUyhQaC1LIrPAQoQPZwDf3jU8TM1HtYTSwtPDya9ssNjXiZxASD9cOjnUBeN3OqzM0PzTvRgLIJcZ2uHKTHsRuFezfRmkoZhgOtzjsylcknjjV2D963Fawwt1imbMzBW87_pNIp87fdTFWJLEQ6JI0s8i7KbE5EIcjTPPeAF6WwKyT82Ts2_4FU7otxb3jIrWdCBFEb9fixPJ5iHgXwnsOMu_rudZg/v85Owvp0LsSaPrjksmv03CiLX4IKwAQU/21)
---
That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens.

And it's not isolated growth anymore.

**We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. **

But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America.

That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation...

And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak.

So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build.

What's different now is the pace.

**Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: **

✅ Arkansas
✅ Florida
✅ Idaho
✅ Indiana
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Oklahoma
✅ South Carolina
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee

That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action.
---
[](https://links.trueamericanconservatives.com/s/c/6PHD0lck6sfVgF6T4vaD2RyApDl9XhFGNvIReKF7uPmPTwnSLq-VWdPMZ__0ipur67idkt-38nsIc0afzcstanqQwOhdQ153mLoaFVeZM0Mv-k_5B8CPZ_fRmcpFhiYPscOUspZi6bv2g2TH8eGC-RbBWmUEzv0tTw-walrgf1fFAoHpyDxuHiZ4VB1ZrsJiYr2wXS_u57M6QxwvRqOf3etBq1dmtPm6yZ4PBp1HVhgkuO93fS2mHAl5h_YPb9PFtUqOO8CIAw51GEl040K4lr6A7fBPUw6bKGfqUCMaP5-EW0PwoKbp8mKv_yoD64yaoJ20vFAiVOXkau1I9VMq3Y0ZbWDVErjyPGNpGjb4gFMVJdjZBgQ0hK9GaqQ71cTljSoMRqSWbwjoC-9cMwDheNhq4WCfRdrqPBbP4YG0wxe7v5Yz5Juxum_ekhWfX19uVgVvhjw7V65I5i7Fbsj6VHED_3caThmGrnml6LnKk30LmxIG1M5ElST-O1eNuF8y6GyVgUEsfNCs107xDc37WdDpY9n6nlNGFbBr-F7FYO-FqSAsSWj4ccKGLel-DXkRyjqVmxKUTDZc23ymdGIhJTMQon98KFaUgPR0GU6GxIKq4MhUEBZAFY9ouhEZcBFuWJ5_gKiceuTz0YNrwMdoHO8h8Ztoh9BuNfC8ScxPSG3IoeXeFPRtWQKqSREYHEy1gHkuTETxuLZNAa2S2jAhBBaIGzJyA1M1slgDuWyKBvPaWxHqkL8i8hdv9Q/atYURpM84Ss4asUNE4iTVCQVfoAmJYj-/21)
---
That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly.

It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up.

Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through.

And right now, that's where we're stretched.

We're not lacking interest or momentum.

We're working to keep up with both.

_So here 's how you can help... _

Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it.

**An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: **

✅ Constitutions.
✅ Chapter guides.
✅ Flags.
✅ Materials to organize and lead.

It turns a student who wants to speak up... _into one who actually does. _

Friend, we're down to the wire. Before I ask you to **_[make an urgent donation to help my campaign ahead of the June 2nd primary,](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/8175?refcode=jtk711-fr-nd&t=2&akid=9812%2E400544%2EDF59JE)_** I'd like to share how I got here and what I am fighting for.
I am the proud descendant of generations of fierce Pueblo women. Their strength and resilience gave me the courage to run for office and fight for New Mexicans, including standing up to Donald Trump.
**I made history as one of the first Native American women elected to Congress and then the first Native American Cabinet Secretary in U.S. history. And _when_ we win this race, I will be the first Native American woman elected Governor in any state. **
**But for me, this work has never been about titles or being the first.**
It’s about fighting for working families, standing up for New Mexicans, and making sure more people have a seat at the table. I want to leave the ladder down for the next generation of leaders and build a government that truly reflects and fights for the people it serves. Higher wages. Lower costs. Stronger education so our kids can read earlier. Protecting and expanding access to healthcare in every part of New Mexico so you can see a doctor even when you’re not sick. Investing in mental and behavioral healthcare, substance use treatments and rehabilitation, and housing stability so we can make our communities safer.
__**That's just a quick look into my vision for the future of New Mexico and our country, and now, I'm asking you to invest in it. I truly believe there's nothing we can't accomplish if we work together, and with thousands of New Mexicans already casting their ballots, I need you with me now more than ever._[So please, friend, can I count on you to chip in $5 or more before the June 2 primary to help me fight for working families, deliver real progress for New Mexicans, and leave the ladder down for the next generation of leaders?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/8175?refcode=jtk711-fr-nd&t=3&akid=9812%2E400544%2EDF59JE)_**

Hello Fellow Patriot, I'd like to introduce myself.

My name is Jackie Mary Auringer, and I'm running for U.S. Congress because I am no longer willing to leave the future of my community in the hands of people I can't trust.

For too long, the voices of families in the Hudson Valley have been ignored or filtered through agendas, which don't reflect what life is really like here, especially as the cost of living continues to rise and families are stretched thinner every year.

**I am not bought by outside interests, nor am I driven by personal ambition.**

My commitment is simple: independence, integrity, and service to every person in New York's 18th District.

My loyalty is to this community, its families, its future, and its strength.

Our nation is too divided, and it's holding us back.

I believe we can do better.

We can lead with purpose, bring people together, focus on real results, support families, and rebuild confidence in our leadership.

My focus is on advancing practical solutions that support families like mine, bolster local businesses, and strengthen our community as a whole.

[](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=1c565534ad5b440a94c1446d66f25be9&_e=h0ItQvksCJK9b9fZbvPEhmISAV2GZAvIIMYZSUJwdRjfRIm9SNP9wcri73gTaG6CPPiNUcRU2l8ASWLXAg-xPxeM92xYPhBWrD1gWWZ8-JsKRoRATxmqBQszTXV1A9d3S4QxrYK2yB5TV58XNK8g7TyVVhzf_kw7NaeCyMWCgYRvTK9ARB2GKuhjMAwaaTc5pJZoUYJc3O24YGNlP-gItj1Ts05J16Ktm1UQg0sJI-ZN3BoMjVn-BlNsslKfQKarTOYp4M609lGFfYv84axGcsXnBthn3rxWHA7mWQ_VLz1eSd-mT0CvoIrpLhQJIhRK3pxJlEDG3Te7jGUhWWj4iQOTJLjvvZsrprceO5kamk-h3rexxhVNpNq0xubiEPXAFszzICxSxtjRBJKCUYJ59AfJ5oYZOOBo2BbzkfYSDP347m0S7gdGuZiu27kuIwUw8vHAwWrhAVmEdDbtrzQGQ7frB1SHe2-TjwBPAPpzYwRYBwN1TE5j-fgxyy5GaB8sH1YC0x_ikLucMCOogAltVSfjrky7bakkgSdKx5xu18NqWKMwIOxYYQQDNgHwmalPeRArFnvs8UbsYrkyglyYwvaOiMI3HoaYFepd0JPobwOMRloFe8ueUo8abtu9_3--0RJJHkTcHpVZQ_m7E-GLggq6Fr-_OssqmYvskicARIDOf_MtzQPb4znM7zDrome2UCocRKIzn6ocIKwntwOxkg%3D%3D)

clean_body: My commitment is simple: independence, integrity, and service to every person in New York's 18th District. | Hello Fellow Patriot, I'd like to introduce myself. My name is Jackie Mary Auringer, and I'm running for U.S. Congress because I am no longer willing to leave the future of my community in the hands of people I can't trust. For too long, the voices of families in the Hudson Valley have been ignored or filtered through agendas, which don't reflect what life is really like here, especially as the cost of living continues to rise and families are stretched thinner every year. I am not bought by outside interests, nor am I driven by personal ambition. My commitment is simple: independence, integrity, and service to every person in New York's 18th District. My loyalty is to this community, its families, its future, and its strength. Our nation is too divided, and it's holding us back. I believe we can do better. We can lead with purpose, bring people together, focus on real results, support families, and rebuild confidence in our leadership. My focus is on advancing practical solutions that support families like mine, bolster local businesses, and strengthen our community as a whole. I'm a proud Hudson Valley native. I was born and raised there and shaped by parents who dedicated their lives to serving it, my mother as a teacher and my father through his construction business. They taught me what matters: responsibility, accountability, and pride in where you come from. Growing up in that environment gave me a firsthand understanding of the importance of hard work, community involvement, and local pride. That perspective is what drives my commitment to ensuring the Hudson Valley is represented by someone who knows it, values it, and will always put it first. I believe that family is the foundation. This lens formed my values and the way I approach servant leadership. That means being a good neighbor and respecting others. The Hudson Valley shaped every part of who I am, and I am committed to protecting our way of life to ensure future generations can thrive in our community. Just like my family did. So, I'm humbly asking for your support before my first campaign deadline on May 31st as I embark on this mission to give my hometown the representation it's longed for. I've got your back, Fellow Patriot. Thank you very much, Jackie Auringer Candidate for Congress NY-18 All The Way With JMA | | Paid for by Jackie Auringer for Congress Don't want to receive any more of our emails? body:
When all else fails, that's when it pays off to have a very, very good insurance policy. | [](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=8a626e204c1646a2a38a120eb47ff836&_e=Ckx8URK9V0LhbAG_x6fGv4VmZLFRCVyosQAzVzWC9U2mloSvp6TmoOXOZnvjBo8v7WiAnp_ii_HM5nwbZGSUG61tYUQKMwvEwJEAWrT0DVxVG4Or_hYqmNgvuzr7iGu_V42ziORVagQU1We7B63AzX27dy35Z5_cmbp9e4z2O9wkExtVb5VC2ViyYKSjz4CtT17Pnz4dff7XNvCuJAyWlj4FKIqFyoB9zSdIUPBpVuptYDkV05RdAbpKQKEiqAdP_7RuHyV0mEEjGclhx-rUuQgM3xhE2mWg20hdDBDscd25JJRI6-8exvWdbnOfuftRRmto4wutx8JyQJE0Wp-VVZ4GMt5kXMUw97BN_aiwrbGcp55n2-me7U_flvktQj97W-RzQr8kH2wxzK6i2PAAyyES6MzHr_BUSlQ_4JJSct_Rdv5DkYhQJnF2gwfch0WONmdgMnDEUNs4H_ajiYFUc2ivBoqiz_8UXNKCnjoRpNcx6-ZwBaYwDlEXnHhl1nlXHgCNQvSsyMwAOSkoPz6NG06uFiAdFXvAKMb60Ak_2l2-5ONed2NogOCdNBhcfalIcUn5rIFngZqYzgl_geB6QEMeG4CJLmpXpvFGH80EnpL7BM7A8WKFxJ3lk0r28rrMY20-N7ownd2FrXoIv9YJpvFImBoSN3YUYTnqwHtuanQdlU5sO6RzosdSEmPHjfzC9JDLAQSt7SQeoqXmWGpp2g%3D%3D)

---
Fellow Conservative,

While Minnesota families struggle with high taxes, rising costs, and stretched budgets, **billions in taxpayer dollars are being stolen through massive fraud in our social welfare programs.**

Just weeks ago, on April 28, federal agents raided 22 sites across the Twin Cities — many of them childcare centers and Medicaid providers — as part of an ongoing investigation into fraud that has already cost us hundreds of millions. This isn’t isolated. It’s part of a pattern of waste and abuse that’s drawn national attention and even federal funding holds.

I’m heading back to Missoula, Montana this week to join Sam for a rally to get out the vote ahead of his primary election on June 2nd.

Sam is exactly the kind of leader we need representing MT-01 in Congress — and with exactly 10 days until his primary election, he needs your help to get there.

Alexandria

I first met Sam Forstag in Missoula last year during the Fighting Oligarchy Tour with Bernie Sanders: Sam is a smokejumper — a firefighter who parachutes out of planes to battle wildfires. He’s also a union leader. Like so many of us, Sam knows what it’s like to work multiple jobs to get by. Sam is exactly the kind of leader we need representing MT-01 in Congress — and with exactly 10 days until his primary election, he needs your help to get there. Sam and I both reject corporate PAC money. We’re not independently wealthy. Our campaigns are possible because of people pitching in what they can because they believe a better world is possible. No matter what, whether you can donate today or not, thank you for being here. I deeply appreciate it. I recently sat down with local healthcare providers here in CA-19 to discuss a critical issue: making sure our Medicare system actually works for both patients and doctors.

Right now, many of our neighbors are struggling to find a doctor in a timely manner or access the specialty care they’ve earned. **That’s why I’m fighting to ensure every senior and family in our community can get the care they need, when they need it.**

I’ve introduced legislation to ensure that Medicare reimburses healthcare providers at the proper levels to keep our hospitals open and ensure that our physicians can keep practicing in our region. I’m going to keep fighting against cuts to provider payments and cuts to Medicaid that undermine our healthcare system and raise costs for working families.

Right now, many of our neighbors are struggling to find a doctor in a timely manner or access the specialty care they’ve earned. I’ve introduced legislation to ensure that Medicare reimburses healthcare providers at the proper levels to keep our hospitals open and ensure that our physicians can keep practicing in our region.
